candidates.normLabel: kaba'ir and sayyi'at: avoiding major sins causes expiation of minor sins and grants noble entry
candidates.definition: In 4:31: If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins and admit you to a noble entrance.

candidates.label: Marital arbitration: sending hakam from each family to resolve spousal discord (shiqaq) with divine facilitation of reconciliation
candidates.normLabel: marital arbitration: sending hakam from each family to resolve spousal discord (shiqaq) with divine facilitation of reconciliation
candidates.definition: In 4:35: And if you fear dissension between the two, send an arbitrator from his people and an arbitrator from her people. If they both desire reconciliation, Allah will cause it between them.

candidates.label: Comprehensive social ethics: worship Allah alone paired with ihsan to ten categories including parents, neighbors, travelers, and those under care
candidates.normLabel: comprehensive social ethics: worship allah alone paired with ihsan to ten categories including parents, neighbors, travelers, and those under care
candidates.definition: In 4:36: Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him, and to parents do good, and to relatives, orphans, the needy, the near neighbor, the neighbor farther away, the companion at your side, the traveler, and those whom your right hands possess. Indeed, Allah does not like those who are self-deluding and boastful.

candidates.label: Three forms of condemned miserliness: personal stinginess, commanding others to be stingy, and spending for ostentation
candidates.normLabel: three forms of condemned miserliness: personal stinginess, commanding others to be stingy, and spending for ostentation
candidates.definition: In 4:37-38: Those who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess and conceal what Allah gave them of His bounty. And those who spend their wealth to be seen by people and do not believe in Allah nor the Last Day.

candidates.label: Shirk as uniquely unforgivable sin: association with Allah never forgiven while all lesser sins remain within divine mercy
candidates.normLabel: shirk as uniquely unforgivable sin: association with allah never forgiven while all lesser sins remain within divine mercy
candidates.definition: In 4:48: Indeed, Allah does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills. And he who associates others with Allah has certainly fabricated a tremendous sin.

candidates.label: Tayammum: dry ablution with clean earth as divine concession when water unavailable due to illness, travel, or other impediments
candidates.normLabel: tayammum: dry ablution with clean earth as divine concession when water unavailable due to illness, travel, or other impediments
candidates.definition: In 4:43: And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women and find no water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and your hands. Indeed, Allah is ever Pardoning and Forgiving.

candidates.label: Scriptural distortion: People of the Book twisting words from their places, defaming religion, and believing in jibt and taghut
candidates.normLabel: scriptural distortion: people of the book twisting words from their places, defaming religion, and believing in jibt and taghut
candidates.definition: In 4:46,51: Among the Jews are those who distort words from their places and say 'We hear and disobey' twisting their tongues and defaming the religion. Have you not seen those given a portion of the Scripture believing in jibt and taghut and saying about disbelievers these are better guided than believers.

candidates.label: Rendering trusts and judging with justice: dual foundation of legitimate governance and social order
candidates.normLabel: rendering trusts and judging with justice: dual foundation of legitimate governance and social order
candidates.definition: In 4:58: Indeed, Allah commands you to render trusts to whom they are due and when you judge between people to judge with justice. Excellent is that which Allah instructs you. Indeed, Allah is ever Hearing and Seeing.

candidates.label: Divine obedience hierarchy: Allah, Messenger, and those in authority; disputes referred back to Allah and Messenger as faith condition
candidates.normLabel: divine obedience hierarchy: allah, messenger, and those in authority; disputes referred back to allah and messenger as faith condition
candidates.definition: In 4:59: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you. And if you disagree over anything, refer it to Allah and the Messenger, if you should believe in Allah and the Last Day. That is the best and best in result.

candidates.label: True faith defined: no belief until accepting prophetic judgment in disputes without inner resistance and submitting completely
candidates.normLabel: true faith defined: no belief until accepting prophetic judgment in disputes without inner resistance and submitting completely
candidates.definition: In 4:65: But no, by your Lord, they will not believe until they make you judge concerning that over which they dispute among themselves and then find within themselves no discomfort from what you have judged and submit in full submission.

candidates.label: Four ranks of divine favor: prophets, truthful affirmers, martyrs, and righteous as companions for the obedient
candidates.normLabel: four ranks of divine favor: prophets, truthful affirmers, martyrs, and righteous as companions for the obedient
candidates.definition: In 4:69: And whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger - those will be with the ones upon whom Allah has bestowed favor of the prophets, the steadfast affirmers of truth, the martyrs and the righteous. And excellent are those as companions.

candidates.label: Fighting for the oppressed: defense of weakened men, women, and children crying for deliverance from oppressive cities
candidates.normLabel: fighting for the oppressed: defense of weakened men, women, and children crying for deliverance from oppressive cities
candidates.definition: In 4:75: And what is the matter with you that you fight not in the cause of Allah and for the oppressed among men, women, and children who say, 'Our Lord, take us out of this city of oppressive people and appoint for us from Yourself a protector and appoint for us from Yourself a helper.'

candidates.label: Theological causality: good comes from Allah while evil comes from oneself establishing asymmetric divine-human attribution
candidates.normLabel: theological causality: good comes from allah while evil comes from oneself establishing asymmetric divine-human attribution
candidates.definition: In 4:78-79: Wherever you are death overtakes you even in fortified towers. If good comes they say this is from Allah; if evil they say this is from you. Say all is from Allah. What comes of good is from Allah; what comes of evil is from yourself.

candidates.label: Quranic coherence argument: absence of internal contradiction offered as evidence of divine authorship
candidates.normLabel: quranic coherence argument: absence of internal contradiction offered as evidence of divine authorship
candidates.definition: In 4:82: Then do they not reflect upon the Quran? If it had been from other than Allah they would have found within it much contradiction.

candidates.label: Intercession moral economy: mediating good earns reward share while mediating evil incurs burden share with Allah as Keeper
candidates.normLabel: intercession moral economy: mediating good earns reward share while mediating evil incurs burden share with allah as keeper
candidates.definition: In 4:85: Whoever intercedes for a good cause will have a share of it; whoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a burden of it. And ever is Allah over all things a Keeper.

candidates.label: Accidental homicide of believer: graduated expiation requiring manumission blood money or fasting based on political relations
candidates.normLabel: accidental homicide of believer: graduated expiation requiring manumission blood money or fasting based on political relations
candidates.definition: In 4:92: Never for believer to kill believer except by mistake. Whoever kills believer by mistake must free believing slave and pay blood money to family unless forgiven. If from hostile believing people free slave only. If from treaty people blood money plus free slave. If unable fast two consecutive months as repentance from Allah.

candidates.label: Verification command (tabayyanoo): mandatory investigation before acting in warfare preventing wrongful targeting of those offering peace
candidates.normLabel: verification command (tabayyanoo): mandatory investigation before acting in warfare preventing wrongful targeting of those offering peace
candidates.definition: In 4:94: O believers when you go forth in Allah's way investigate carefully and do not say to one who offers peace 'you are not a believer' aspiring for worldly goods. With Allah are many acquisitions. You were like that before then Allah favored you so investigate.

candidates.label: Mujahideen preference: active striving with wealth and selves ranked above sitting believers by degrees though both promised good
candidates.normLabel: mujahideen preference: active striving with wealth and selves ranked above sitting believers by degrees though both promised good
candidates.definition: In 4:95-96: Not equal are sitting believers other than disabled and mujahideen in Allah's way with wealth and selves. Allah preferred mujahideen by degree. Both promised best. Allah further preferred mujahideen with great reward: degrees from Him forgiveness and mercy.

candidates.label: Musta'dafun exemption: genuinely oppressed men women children unable to devise plan or find way excused from emigration obligation
candidates.normLabel: musta'dafun exemption: genuinely oppressed men women children unable to devise plan or find way excused from emigration obligation
candidates.definition: In 4:98-99: Except the oppressed among men women and children who cannot devise a plan nor find a way. For those perhaps Allah will pardon them. Allah is ever Pardoning Forgiving.

candidates.label: Fear-prayer (salat al-khawf): detailed protocol preserving communal worship under military threat with rotating armed parties
candidates.normLabel: fear-prayer (salat al-khawf): detailed protocol preserving communal worship under military threat with rotating armed parties
candidates.definition: In 4:101-103: When traveling no blame for shortening prayer if fearing disbelievers. When among them leading prayer let party stand with you carrying arms; when prostrated let other party come behind. If rain or ill lay down arms but take precaution. When finished remember Allah standing sitting lying. When secure establish prayer; prayer is timed decree upon believers.

candidates.label: Opposition to Messenger after guidance: following other than believers' path leads to Hellfire as wretched destination
candidates.normLabel: opposition to messenger after guidance: following other than believers' path leads to hellfire as wretched destination
candidates.definition: In 4:115: And whoever opposes the Messenger after guidance has become clear to him and follows other than the way of the believers We will give him what he has taken and drive him into Hell and evil it is as a destination.

candidates.label: Private conversation ethics: most secret talk has no good except enjoining charity kindness or reconciliation between people
candidates.normLabel: private conversation ethics: most secret talk has no good except enjoining charity kindness or reconciliation between people
candidates.definition: In 4:114: No good in much of their private conversation except one who enjoins charity or kindness or reconciliation between people. Whoever does that seeking Allah's pleasure We will give great reward.

candidates.label: Shaytan's operational methodology: systematic program of misleading arousing desires commanding alteration of divine creation
candidates.normLabel: shaytan's operational methodology: systematic program of misleading arousing desires commanding alteration of divine creation
candidates.definition: In 4:119: Shaytan declares his program: I will mislead them, arouse sinful desires in them, command them to slit cattle ears, and command them to change Allah's creation. Taking him as ally instead of Allah is clear loss.

candidates.label: Salvation insufficiency of wishful thinking: neither Muslim nor People of Scripture aspirations substitute for accountability
candidates.normLabel: salvation insufficiency of wishful thinking: neither muslim nor people of scripture aspirations substitute for accountability
candidates.definition: In 4:123: Paradise is not obtained by your wishful thinking nor by that of the People of the Scripture. Whoever does evil will be recompensed for it and will find no protector or helper besides Allah.

candidates.label: Gender-inclusive salvation: righteous deeds by male or female believer equally admitted to Paradise without injustice
candidates.normLabel: gender-inclusive salvation: righteous deeds by male or female believer equally admitted to paradise without injustice
candidates.definition: In 4:124: Whoever does righteous deeds whether male or female while being a believer - those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged even as much as the speck on a date seed.

candidates.label: Orphan girls' marital rights: prohibition against marrying orphan wards while withholding prescribed shares
candidates.normLabel: orphan girls' marital rights: prohibition against marrying orphan wards while withholding prescribed shares
candidates.definition: In 4:127: They consult you about women. Say Allah instructs concerning orphan girls to whom you do not give what is prescribed for them yet you desire to marry them and concerning oppressed children and maintaining orphans justly.

candidates.label: Polygamous equity limitation: acknowledged impossibility of perfect emotional equality with prohibition against total neglect
candidates.normLabel: polygamous equity limitation: acknowledged impossibility of perfect emotional equality with prohibition against total neglect
candidates.definition: In 4:129: You will never be able to be equal between wives even if you strive. So do not incline completely leaving one hanging. If you reform and fear Allah then Allah is Forgiving Merciful.

candidates.label: Absolute justice imperative: persistent standing firm for justice as witnesses for Allah overriding self-interest kinship and class
candidates.normLabel: absolute justice imperative: persistent standing firm for justice as witnesses for allah overriding self-interest kinship and class
candidates.definition: In 4:135: O believers be persistently standing firm in justice witnesses for Allah even against yourselves or parents or relatives whether rich or poor Allah is more worthy of both. Do not follow inclination lest you avoid justice.

candidates.label: Repeated apostasy cycle: belief-disbelief-belief-disbelief escalation resulting in permanent divine abandonment
candidates.normLabel: repeated apostasy cycle: belief-disbelief-belief-disbelief escalation resulting in permanent divine abandonment
candidates.definition: In 4:137: Those who believed then disbelieved then believed then disbelieved then increased in disbelief - Allah will never forgive them nor guide them to a way.

candidates.label: Sacrilege withdrawal protocol: mandatory departure from company denying or mocking divine ayat until topic changes
candidates.normLabel: sacrilege withdrawal protocol: mandatory departure from company denying or mocking divine ayat until topic changes
candidates.definition: In 4:140: It has been revealed in the Book that when you hear Allah's ayat denied and mocked do not sit with them until they enter different conversation otherwise you are like them. Allah will gather hypocrites and disbelievers in Hell together.

candidates.label: Selective belief invalidity: distinguishing between Allah and His messengers constitutes true disbelief not partial faith
candidates.normLabel: selective belief invalidity: distinguishing between allah and his messengers constitutes true disbelief not partial faith
candidates.definition: In 4:150-151: Those who disbelieve in Allah and His messengers wishing to distinguish between them saying we believe in some and reject some wanting a middle way - those are the disbelievers truly and We have prepared for disbelievers humiliating punishment.

candidates.label: Divine punishment non-necessity: Allah has no interest in punishment when gratitude and belief are present
candidates.normLabel: divine punishment non-necessity: allah has no interest in punishment when gratitude and belief are present
candidates.definition: In 4:147: What would Allah do with your punishment if you are grateful and believe? And ever is Allah Appreciative and Knowing.

candidates.label: Isa non-crucifixion and divine raising: definitive Quranic correction denying killing or crucifixion affirming elevation to Allah
candidates.normLabel: isa non-crucifixion and divine raising: definitive quranic correction denying killing or crucifixion affirming elevation to allah
candidates.definition: In 4:157-158: They said we killed the Messiah Isa son of Maryam messenger of Allah but they did not kill him nor crucify him but it was made to appear so to them. Those who differ are in doubt with no knowledge except assumption. They did not kill him for certain. Rather Allah raised him to Himself and Allah is Exalted in Might Wise.

candidates.label: Covenant-breaking cycle: Bani Israel's repeated violations including calf worship Sabbath transgression prophet-killing and heart-sealing
candidates.normLabel: covenant-breaking cycle: bani israel's repeated violations including calf worship sabbath transgression prophet-killing and heart-sealing
candidates.definition: In 4:153-155: They asked Musa to show Allah openly so thunderbolt seized them; then took calf after clear proofs; raised Mount for covenant enter gate bowing do not transgress Sabbath took solemn covenant; because breaking covenant rejecting signs killing prophets unjustly saying hearts wrapped Allah sealed them for disbelief so believe not except few.

candidates.label: Slander against Maryam: great fabrication cited as distinct transgression alongside covenant-breaking and disbelief
candidates.normLabel: slander against maryam: great fabrication cited as distinct transgression alongside covenant-breaking and disbelief
candidates.definition: In 4:156: And for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander.

candidates.label: Riba and unjust wealth consumption: financial transgressions cited as grounds for punitive dietary restrictions and painful punishment
candidates.normLabel: riba and unjust wealth consumption: financial transgressions cited as grounds for punitive dietary restrictions and painful punishment
candidates.definition: In 4:160-161: For wrongdoing of those who were Jews We made unlawful good things previously lawful and for their averting from Allah's way many; and their taking riba while forbidden and consuming people's wealth unjustly. We prepared for disbelievers among them painful punishment.

candidates.label: Prophetic revelation continuity: Muhammad's inspiration identical in kind to Nuh Ibrahim and thirteen named prophets establishing unified message
candidates.normLabel: prophetic revelation continuity: muhammad's inspiration identical in kind to nuh ibrahim and thirteen named prophets establishing unified message
candidates.definition: In 4:163-164: Indeed We revealed to you as We revealed to Nuh and prophets after him. We revealed to Ibrahim Ismail Ishaq Yaqub tribes Isa Ayyub Yunus Harun Sulayman and gave Dawud Zabur. Messengers We mentioned before and messengers We did not mention. Allah spoke directly to Musa.

candidates.label: Triple witness to revelation: Allah His knowledge and angels jointly attest to divine origin of Quranic revelation
candidates.normLabel: triple witness to revelation: allah his knowledge and angels jointly attest to divine origin of quranic revelation
candidates.definition: In 4:166: But Allah bears witness to what He sent down to you. He sent it down with His knowledge and the angels bear witness. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.

candidates.label: Isa ontological precision: defined as messenger of Allah His Word cast to Maryam and spirit from Him explicitly excluding divinity
candidates.normLabel: isa ontological precision: defined as messenger of allah his word cast to maryam and spirit from him explicitly excluding divinity
candidates.definition: In 4:171: O People of Scripture do not exceed limits in religion nor say about Allah except truth. The Messiah Isa son of Maryam was only a messenger of Allah and His Word which He cast to Maryam and a spirit from Him. So believe in Allah and His messengers. Do not say Three desist it is better for you. Allah is only one God exalted above having a son.

candidates.label: Religious excess prohibition: ghuluww (exceeding proper bounds) identified as root error addressed to People of Scripture
candidates.normLabel: religious excess prohibition: ghuluww (exceeding proper bounds) identified as root error addressed to people of scripture
candidates.definition: In 4:171: O People of Scripture do not exceed limits in your religion and do not say about Allah except the truth.

candidates.label: Servitude theology: Isa and angels as paradigmatic servants who would never disdain worship contrasting with human arrogance
candidates.normLabel: servitude theology: isa and angels as paradigmatic servants who would never disdain worship contrasting with human arrogance
candidates.definition: In 4:172-173: Never would the Messiah disdain to be a servant of Allah nor the angels near to Him. Whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant He will gather them all to Himself. As for those who believed and did righteous deeds He gives full rewards and increases from His bounty. As for those who disdained and were arrogant He punishes with painful punishment and they find no protector or helper besides Allah.

candidates.label: Kalalah inheritance ruling: sibling inheritance shares when deceased leaves neither descendants nor ascendants with gender-differentiated portions
candidates.normLabel: kalalah inheritance ruling: sibling inheritance shares when deceased leaves neither descendants nor ascendants with gender-differentiated portions
candidates.definition: In 4:176: They request ruling. Say Allah gives ruling concerning kalalah: if man dies leaving no child but has sister she gets half what he left; he inherits from her if she has no child; if two sisters they get two-thirds; if siblings male and female male gets share of two females. Allah makes clear for you lest you go astray. Allah is Knower of all things.

candidates.label: Perfection of religion: divine declaration of completed revelation finalized favor and approved Islam as definitive way of life
candidates.normLabel: perfection of religion: divine declaration of completed revelation finalized favor and approved islam as definitive way of life
candidates.definition: In 5:3: This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon you and have approved for you Islam as religion. Declared alongside dietary legislation marking comprehensive legal-theological culmination.

candidates.label: Cooperative ethics: positive obligation to collaborate in righteousness and taqwa with corresponding prohibition against collaboration in sin and aggression
candidates.normLabel: cooperative ethics: positive obligation to collaborate in righteousness and taqwa with corresponding prohibition against collaboration in sin and aggression
candidates.definition: In 5:2: Cooperate in righteousness and taqwa and do not cooperate in sin and aggression. And fear Allah; indeed Allah is severe in penalty.

candidates.label: Regulated interfaith permeability: mutual food permissibility with People of Book and marriage to their chaste women under specified conditions
candidates.normLabel: regulated interfaith permeability: mutual food permissibility with people of book and marriage to their chaste women under specified conditions
candidates.definition: In 5:5: This day good things made lawful; food of those given Scripture lawful for you and your food lawful for them; chaste women from believers and chaste women from those given Scripture before you when given due compensation desiring chastity not fornication or secret lovers.

candidates.label: Tayammum concession: dry ablution with clean earth when water unavailable expressing divine legislative intent of ease not hardship
candidates.normLabel: tayammum concession: dry ablution with clean earth when water unavailable expressing divine legislative intent of ease not hardship
candidates.definition: In 5:6: If ill or traveling or from privy or contacted women and no water found then seek clean earth and wipe faces and hands. Allah does not intend difficulty but intends purification and completion of favor for gratitude.

candidates.label: Justice overriding enmity: hatred of any people must never prevent just conduct; justice itself is nearer to taqwa
candidates.normLabel: justice overriding enmity: hatred of any people must never prevent just conduct; justice itself is nearer to taqwa
candidates.definition: In 5:8: O believers be persistently standing firm for Allah witnesses in justice; do not let hatred of a people prevent justice. Be just; that is nearer to taqwa. Fear Allah; Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

candidates.label: Covenant breach pattern: parallel violation histories of Israelite and Christian communities producing hardened hearts word-distortion and inter-communal enmity
candidates.normLabel: covenant breach pattern: parallel violation histories of israelite and christian communities producing hardened hearts word-distortion and inter-communal enmity
candidates.definition: In 5:12-14: Allah took covenant from Children of Israel appointing twelve leaders with conditions; whoever disbelieved after that strayed. For breaking covenant We cursed them made hearts hard they distort words forgot portion. From Christians We took covenant they forgot portion so We caused enmity and hatred between them until Resurrection.

candidates.label: Refutation of Christian divinization: explicit rejection of Allah-is-Messiah and third-of-three claims with logical arguments from divine sovereignty and Messiah's own testimony
candidates.normLabel: refutation of christian divinization: explicit rejection of allah-is-messiah and third-of-three claims with logical arguments from divine sovereignty and messiah's own testimony
candidates.definition: In 5:17: They have disbelieved who say Allah is Messiah son of Maryam. Say who could prevent Allah if He intended to destroy Messiah his mother and everyone on earth? To Allah belongs dominion of heavens earth and between them He creates what He wills Allah over all things Competent.

candidates.label: Holy Land refusal: Israelite defiance of divine command to enter sacred territory resulting in forty-year wandering as collective consequence of communal disobedience
candidates.normLabel: holy land refusal: israelite defiance of divine command to enter sacred territory resulting in forty-year wandering as collective consequence of communal disobedience
candidates.definition: In 5:21-26: Musa commanded people enter Holy Land Allah assigned; they refused citing tyrannical inhabitants; two faithful men urged entry with tawakkul; people defiantly said go you and your Lord fight we sit here; Musa appealed to Allah; Allah decreed forty years wandering in land; do not grieve over defiantly disobedient people.

candidates.label: Sanctity of life universal formula: unjust killing of one soul equals killing all mankind; saving one equals saving all mankind
candidates.normLabel: sanctity of life universal formula: unjust killing of one soul equals killing all mankind; saving one equals saving all mankind
candidates.definition: In 5:32: Because of that We decreed upon Children of Israel that whoever kills a soul not for soul or corruption in land it is as if he killed mankind entirely and whoever saves one it is as if he saved mankind entirely. Our messengers came with clear proofs then many transgressed after that in land.

candidates.label: Hirabah penal framework: graduated punishments for armed rebellion against Allah and Messenger causing societal corruption with repentance exception before capture
candidates.normLabel: hirabah penal framework: graduated punishments for armed rebellion against allah and messenger causing societal corruption with repentance exception before capture
candidates.definition: In 5:33-34: Penalty for those waging war against Allah and Messenger striving in land for corruption: killed or crucified or hands and feet cut off from opposite sides or exiled from land; disgrace in world great punishment hereafter. Except those who repent before you overcome them; know Allah Forgiving Merciful.

candidates.label: Theft penalty and repentance: hand amputation as divine deterrent paired with repentance acceptance for reforming offenders
candidates.normLabel: theft penalty and repentance: hand amputation as divine deterrent paired with repentance acceptance for reforming offenders
candidates.definition: In 5:38-39: The thief male and female cut off their hands as recompense for what they earned as deterrent from Allah; Allah Exalted Wise. But whoever repents after wrongdoing and reforms indeed Allah turns to him; Allah Forgiving Merciful.

candidates.label: Divine sovereignty over punishment and forgiveness: Allah exclusively determines whom to punish and forgive grounded in universal dominion and capability
candidates.normLabel: divine sovereignty over punishment and forgiveness: allah exclusively determines whom to punish and forgive grounded in universal dominion and capability
candidates.definition: In 5:40: Do you not know that to Allah belongs dominion of heavens and earth? He punishes whom He wills and forgives whom He wills. And Allah is over all things Capable.

candidates.label: Judging by divine revelation: three-tiered condemnation equating failure to judge by Allah's revelation with disbelief wrongdoing and defiant disobedience
candidates.normLabel: judging by divine revelation: three-tiered condemnation equating failure to judge by allah's revelation with disbelief wrongdoing and defiant disobedience
candidates.definition: In 5:44-47: Whoever does not judge by what Allah revealed those are disbelievers (5:44). Whoever does not judge by what Allah revealed those are wrongdoers (5:45). Whoever does not judge by what Allah revealed those are defiantly disobedient (5:47). Applied respectively to Torah judges retribution law and Gospel judges.

candidates.label: Legal pluralism as divine design: distinct shir'ah and minhaj for each community serving as test; competitive goodness replacing uniformity
candidates.normLabel: legal pluralism as divine design: distinct shir'ah and minhaj for each community serving as test; competitive goodness replacing uniformity
candidates.definition: In 5:48: To each of you We prescribed a law and method. Had Allah willed He would have made you one nation but to test you in what He gave you. So race to good deeds. To Allah is your return all together and He will inform you about what you differed.

candidates.label: Rejection of pre-Islamic judgment: jahiliyyah standards explicitly inferior to divine judgment for people of certainty
candidates.normLabel: rejection of pre-islamic judgment: jahiliyyah standards explicitly inferior to divine judgment for people of certainty
candidates.definition: In 5:50: Is it the judgment of ignorance they desire? Who is better than Allah in judgment for a people who are certain?

candidates.label: Walayah theology: exclusive loyalty to Allah Messenger and believing community; alliance with opponents constitutes identity transfer
candidates.normLabel: walayah theology: exclusive loyalty to allah messenger and believing community; alliance with opponents constitutes identity transfer
candidates.definition: In 5:51-56: O believers do not take Jews and Christians as allies; they are allies of one another; whoever takes them as ally is of them. Your ally is only Allah His Messenger and those who believe who establish prayer give zakah while bowing. Whoever takes Allah Messenger and believers as allies — party of Allah are victorious.

candidates.label: Apostasy replacement: divine guarantee to replace defectors with people characterized by mutual love humility toward believers and firmness against disbelievers
candidates.normLabel: apostasy replacement: divine guarantee to replace defectors with people characterized by mutual love humility toward believers and firmness against disbelievers
candidates.definition: In 5:54: O believers whoever turns back from his religion Allah will bring a people He loves and who love Him humble toward believers firm against disbelievers striving in Allah's way not fearing blame of a critic. That is Allah's favor He gives to whom He wills; Allah All-Encompassing Knowing.

candidates.label: Balligh imperative: absolute obligation to convey entire revelation with failure equating to non-conveyance; divine protection guaranteed against human opposition
candidates.normLabel: balligh imperative: absolute obligation to convey entire revelation with failure equating to non-conveyance; divine protection guaranteed against human opposition
candidates.definition: In 5:67: O Messenger convey what has been revealed to you from your Lord. If you do not then you have not conveyed His message. And Allah will protect you from the people. Indeed Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.

candidates.label: Universal salvation criterion: believers Jews Sabeans and Christians who believe in Allah and Last Day and do righteous deeds assured freedom from fear and grief
candidates.normLabel: universal salvation criterion: believers jews sabeans and christians who believe in allah and last day and do righteous deeds assured freedom from fear and grief
candidates.definition: In 5:69: Indeed those who believed and those who were Jews and Sabeans and Christians — whoever believed in Allah and the Last Day and did righteousness — no fear upon them nor do they grieve.

candidates.label: Religious leadership accountability: rabbis and scholars condemned for failing to forbid sinful speech and illicit consumption among their communities
candidates.normLabel: religious leadership accountability: rabbis and scholars condemned for failing to forbid sinful speech and illicit consumption among their communities
candidates.definition: In 5:63: Why do the rabbis and religious scholars not forbid them from saying what is sinful and devouring what is unlawful? How wretched is what they have been practicing.

candidates.label: Spiritual blindness cycle: assuming immunity from divine trial leads to loss of perception; repentance accepted then blindness returns for many
candidates.normLabel: spiritual blindness cycle: assuming immunity from divine trial leads to loss of perception; repentance accepted then blindness returns for many
candidates.definition: In 5:71: They thought there would be no fitnah so they became blind and deaf. Then Allah turned to them in forgiveness; then many of them became blind and deaf again. And Allah is Seeing of what they do.

candidates.label: Messiah's self-testimony: Isa ibn Maryam explicitly commands worship of Allah alone and denies divinity through shared human nature with his mother
candidates.normLabel: messiah's self-testimony: isa ibn maryam explicitly commands worship of allah alone and denies divinity through shared human nature with his mother
candidates.definition: In 5:72: The Messiah said O Children of Israel worship Allah my Lord and your Lord. In 5:75: The Messiah son of Mary was not but a messenger; messengers passed before him. His mother was a siddiqah. They both used to eat food.

candidates.label: Religious excess prohibition: ghuluww (exceeding bounds) in religion forbidden; following desires of previously misguided communities warned against
candidates.normLabel: religious excess prohibition: ghuluww (exceeding bounds) in religion forbidden; following desires of previously misguided communities warned against
candidates.definition: In 5:77: Say O People of the Scripture do not exceed limits in your religion beyond the truth and do not follow the inclinations of a people who had gone astray before and misled many and have strayed from the soundness of the way.

candidates.label: Communal moral enforcement failure: not forbidding mutual wrongdoing cited as ground for divine curse alongside disobedience and transgression
candidates.normLabel: communal moral enforcement failure: not forbidding mutual wrongdoing cited as ground for divine curse alongside disobedience and transgression
candidates.definition: In 5:78-79: Cursed were those who disbelieved among Children of Israel by tongue of Dawud and Isa son of Maryam because they disobeyed and transgressed. They used not to prevent one another from wrongdoing they did. How wretched what they were doing.

candidates.label: Christian affection proximity: Christians identified as nearest in mawaddah to believers due to presence of priests monks and absence of arrogance
candidates.normLabel: christian affection proximity: christians identified as nearest in mawaddah to believers due to presence of priests monks and absence of arrogance
candidates.definition: In 5:82: You will find nearest of them in affection to the believers those who say we are Christians. That is because among them are priests and monks and they are not arrogant.

candidates.label: Truth recognition through tears: believing Christians' eyes overflow with tears upon hearing revelation due to recognized truth; immediate faith confession and witness-status request
candidates.normLabel: truth recognition through tears: believing christians' eyes overflow with tears upon hearing revelation due to recognized truth; immediate faith confession and witness-status request
candidates.definition: In 5:83-84: When they hear what was revealed to the Messenger you see their eyes overflowing with tears from what they recognized of the truth. They say our Lord we have believed so register us among the witnesses. Why should we not believe in Allah and what came to us of truth hoping our Lord admits us with the righteous.

candidates.label: Oath legislation: unintentional oaths (laghw) exempt from liability; binding intentional oaths require graded expiation; guard oaths command linked to gratitude
candidates.normLabel: oath legislation: unintentional oaths (laghw) exempt from liability; binding intentional oaths require graded expiation; guard oaths command linked to gratitude
candidates.definition: In 5:89: Allah will not impose blame for laghw in your oaths but will impose blame for what you bound of oaths. Its expiation is feeding ten needy from average family food or clothing them or freeing a slave. Whoever cannot find then fasting three days. That is expiation for oaths when sworn. Guard your oaths. Thus Allah clarifies signs that you may be grateful.

candidates.label: Satanic quartet: intoxicants gambling stone altars divining arrows declared unified rijs from shaytan's work; avoidance linked to success; shaytan's objectives exposed as animosity and hindering dhikr-salah
candidates.normLabel: satanic quartet: intoxicants gambling stone altars divining arrows declared unified rijs from shaytan's work; avoidance linked to success; shaytan's objectives exposed as animosity and hindering dhikr-salah
candidates.definition: In 5:90-91: O believers indeed intoxicants gambling stone altars divining arrows are defilement from shaytan's work so avoid it that you may succeed. Shaytan only wants to cause between you animosity and hatred through intoxicants and gambling and hinder you from remembrance of Allah and prayer. So will you not desist?

candidates.label: Ihram hunting test: Allah tests believers with accessible game during sacred state to distinguish unseen taqwa; intentional violation requires judicial compensation; past violations pardoned repeat offenses punished
candidates.normLabel: ihram hunting test: allah tests believers with accessible game during sacred state to distinguish unseen taqwa; intentional violation requires judicial compensation; past violations pardoned repeat offenses punished
candidates.definition: In 5:94-95: O believers Allah will test you with something of game your hands and spears reach that Allah may know who fears Him unseen. Whoever transgresses after that has painful punishment. Do not kill game while in ihram. Whoever kills intentionally compensation is equivalent domestic animal judged by two just men among you as offering reaching Kaaba or expiation feeding needy or fasting equivalent to taste consequence. Allah pardoned what is past; whoever returns Allah takes retribution. Allah Exalted Owner of Retribution.

candidates.label: Past consumption pardon: believers who consumed prohibited items before legislation not blamed if they now maintain taqwa faith and righteous deeds in progressive cycles
candidates.normLabel: past consumption pardon: believers who consumed prohibited items before legislation not blamed if they now maintain taqwa faith and righteous deeds in progressive cycles
candidates.definition: In 5:93: There is no blame on those who believed and did righteous deeds concerning what they tasted if they feared Allah and believed and did righteous deeds then feared Allah and believed then feared Allah and did good. And Allah loves the doers of good.

candidates.label: Distress-question prohibition: believers forbidden from asking about matters whose disclosure would cause distress; past inquiries pardoned; previous communities asked then disbelieved
candidates.normLabel: distress-question prohibition: believers forbidden from asking about matters whose disclosure would cause distress; past inquiries pardoned; previous communities asked then disbelieved
candidates.definition: In 5:101-102: O believers do not ask about things which if made plain would distress you. If you ask during Quran revelation they will be made plain. Allah has pardoned them. A people before you asked such questions then became disbelievers.

candidates.label: Pre-Islamic animal taboos rejected: bahirah saibah wasilah ham declared non-divine innovations; disbelievers fabricate lies against Allah; most lack reasoning
candidates.normLabel: pre-islamic animal taboos rejected: bahirah saibah wasilah ham declared non-divine innovations; disbelievers fabricate lies against allah; most lack reasoning
candidates.definition: In 5:103: Allah has not appointed bahirah or saibah or wasilah or ham. But those who disbelieve fabricate lies against Allah and most of them do not reason.

candidates.label: Individual responsibility principle: upon you is yourselves; others' straying cannot harm the guided; return to Allah who informs of all deeds
candidates.normLabel: individual responsibility principle: upon you is yourselves; others' straying cannot harm the guided; return to allah who informs of all deeds
candidates.definition: In 5:105: O believers upon you is yourselves. Whoever goes astray will not harm you when you have been guided. To Allah is your return all together and He will inform you of what you used to do.

candidates.label: Bequest testimony framework: two just witnesses required; travel accommodation with outsider witnesses; oath reinforcement prohibiting price-exchange and concealment; perjury replacement with counter-oath mechanism
candidates.normLabel: bequest testimony framework: two just witnesses required; travel accommodation with outsider witnesses; oath reinforcement prohibiting price-exchange and concealment; perjury replacement with counter-oath mechanism
candidates.definition: In 5:106-108: Testimony among you when death approaches at bequest time: two just men from you or two others if traveling struck by death disaster. Detain after prayer swear by Allah we will not exchange for price even near relative nor conceal Allah's testimony. If found guilty of sin two others stand replacing them swearing our testimony truer not transgressed. That makes more likely true testimony or fear oaths returned. Fear Allah listen; Allah guides not fasiqeen.

candidates.label: Isa's miracles qualified by bi-idhni: every miracle (clay bird healing raising dead) explicitly performed by divine permission establishing Allah as sole agent
candidates.normLabel: isa's miracles qualified by bi-idhni: every miracle (clay bird healing raising dead) explicitly performed by divine permission establishing allah as sole agent
candidates.definition: In 5:110: When Allah said O Jesus son of Mary remember My favor upon you and your mother when I supported you with Holy Spirit you spoke to people in cradle and maturity I taught you Book wisdom Torah Gospel you created from clay like bird form by My permission breathed into it became bird by My permission healed blind and leper by My permission brought forth dead by My permission.

candidates.label: Disciples' Muslim identity: hawariyyoon explicitly confess belief in Allah and messenger and request witness-status as Muslims establishing early Christian community as submitting believers
candidates.normLabel: disciples' muslim identity: hawariyyoon explicitly confess belief in allah and messenger and request witness-status as muslims establishing early christian community as submitting believers
candidates.definition: In 5:111: When I inspired to the disciples believe in Me and My messenger they said we have believed so bear witness that we are Muslims.

candidates.label: Ma'idah supplication model: Isa teaches proper prayer etiquette addressing Allah as Rabbana requesting table as eid-sign; divine grant accompanied by unique punishment warning for post-sign disbelief
candidates.normLabel: ma'idah supplication model: isa teaches proper prayer etiquette addressing allah as rabbana requesting table as eid-sign; divine grant accompanied by unique punishment warning for post-sign disbelief
candidates.definition: In 5:114-115: Isa said O Allah our Lord send down upon us table from heaven as festival for first and last of us and sign from You provide for us You are best of providers. Allah said I will send it down but whoever disbelieves after from among you I will punish with punishment I have not punished anyone in the worlds.

candidates.label: Isa's eschatological tawheed testimony: denies commanding worship of self or mother; affirms exclusive message was worship Allah my Lord your Lord; asymmetric knowledge proves creaturely status
candidates.normLabel: isa's eschatological tawheed testimony: denies commanding worship of self or mother; affirms exclusive message was worship allah my lord your lord; asymmetric knowledge proves creaturely status
candidates.definition: In 5:116-117: Allah said O Jesus did you say to people take me and my mother as deities besides Allah? He said Exalted are You! Not for me to say what I have no right. If I had said it You would have known. You know what is in myself I do not know what is in Yourself. You are Knower of unseen. I said only what You commanded: worship Allah my Lord and your Lord.

candidates.label: Truthfulness day: sidq benefits sadiqeen on Judgment Day; reward is eternal gardens with rivers; mutual divine-human pleasure (radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu) as peak salvation state
candidates.normLabel: truthfulness day: sidq benefits sadiqeen on judgment day; reward is eternal gardens with rivers; mutual divine-human pleasure (radiya allahu aaanhum waradoo aaanhu) as peak salvation state
candidates.definition: In 5:119: Allah said this is the Day when truthfulness benefits the truthful. For them are gardens beneath which rivers flow abiding forever. Allah is pleased with them and they with Him. That is the great attainment.

candidates.label: Absolute divine dominion: surah closes declaring Allah's ownership of heavens earth and all within; He is over all things Capable (Qadeer) as final theological statement
candidates.normLabel: absolute divine dominion: surah closes declaring allah's ownership of heavens earth and all within; he is over all things capable (qadeer) as final theological statement
candidates.definition: In 5:120: To Allah belongs dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. And He is over all things Capable.

candidates.label: Creation-duality and sign-rejection: Allah created heavens earth made darkness light yet disbelievers equate others; no sign comes except they turn away; denied truth awaits news of ridicule
candidates.normLabel: creation-duality and sign-rejection: allah created heavens earth made darkness light yet disbelievers equate others; no sign comes except they turn away; denied truth awaits news of ridicule
candidates.definition: In 6:1-5: All praise to Allah who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light. Then those who disbelieve equate others with their Lord. No sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away. They denied the truth when it came to them so there will come to them news of what they used to ridicule.

candidates.label: Historical civilization cycle: previous generations established with superior resources rain rivers yet destroyed for sins replaced by others; empirical argument against complacency
candidates.normLabel: historical civilization cycle: previous generations established with superior resources rain rivers yet destroyed for sins replaced by others; empirical argument against complacency
candidates.definition: In 6:6: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you? And We sent rain upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them another generation.

candidates.label: Hypothetical scenarios proving obstinacy: even written scripture on page touched by hands called magic; angel demanded but sending would end respite; angel in human form causes same confusion; previous messengers ridiculed and mockers enveloped
candidates.normLabel: hypothetical scenarios proving obstinacy: even written scripture on page touched by hands called magic; angel demanded but sending would end respite; angel in human form causes same confusion; previous messengers ridiculed and mockers enveloped
candidates.definition: In 6:7-10: Even if We sent down a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands the disbelievers would say this is obvious magic. They say why was an angel not sent down? If We sent an angel the matter would be decided then they would not be reprieved. If We made him an angel We would make him a man and cover them with confusion. Messengers were ridiculed before you and those who mocked were enveloped by what they ridiculed.

candidates.label: Self-decreed mercy and certain gathering: Allah wrote mercy upon Himself as voluntary commitment; will surely assemble for Resurrection Day no doubt; self-losers do not believe
candidates.normLabel: self-decreed mercy and certain gathering: allah wrote mercy upon himself as voluntary commitment; will surely assemble for resurrection day no doubt; self-losers do not believe
candidates.definition: In 6:12: Say to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth? Say to Allah. He has decreed upon Himself mercy. He will surely assemble you for the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt. Those who will lose themselves do not believe.

candidates.label: Harm-good monopoly and attribute cluster: if Allah touches harm none removes except Him; if good He is Capable; He is Subduer above servants Wise Acquainted establishing tawheed through experiential dependency
candidates.normLabel: harm-good monopoly and attribute cluster: if allah touches harm none removes except him; if good he is capable; he is subduer above servants wise acquainted establishing tawheed through experiential dependency
candidates.definition: In 6:17-18: If Allah touches you with harm there is no remover except Him. If He touches you with good He is over all things Capable. He is the Subduer above His servants and He is the Wise the Acquainted.

candidates.label: Witness-Quran-tawheed-barā'a complex: Allah greatest witness between Prophet and audience; Quran revealed to warn you and whomever reaches; He is one God; I am free from what you associate; Scripture-people recognize truth as sons
candidates.normLabel: witness-quran-tawheed-barā'a complex: allah greatest witness between prophet and audience; quran revealed to warn you and whomever reaches; he is one god; i am free from what you associate; scripture-people recognize truth as sons
candidates.definition: In 6:19-20: Say what thing is greatest in testimony? Say Allah is witness between me and you. This Quran was revealed to warn you and whomever it reaches. Do you testify that with Allah there are other deities? Say I will not testify. Say He is but one God and I am free from what you associate. Those given Scripture recognize it as they recognize their sons. Those who lose themselves do not believe.

candidates.label: Supreme injustice and eschatological self-deception: who more unjust than fabricates against Allah or denies signs? wrongdoers fail; Day gather ask polytheists where partners? swear we were not polytheists; lied against selves lost fabricated deities
candidates.normLabel: supreme injustice and eschatological self-deception: who more unjust than fabricates against allah or denies signs? wrongdoers fail; day gather ask polytheists where partners? swear we were not polytheists; lied against selves lost fabricated deities
candidates.definition: In 6:21-24: Who is more unjust than one who fabricates against Allah a lie or denies His signs? The wrongdoers will not succeed. Day We gather them all then say to those who associated where are your partners you claimed? Their examination-excuse is only saying by Allah our Lord we were not polytheists. See how they lied against themselves and lost from them what they fabricated.

candidates.label: Cognitive barriers and irreversible regret: heart-coverings and ear-deafness prevent understanding even seeing every sign; legends-dismissal as tactic; self-destructive avoidance unrecognized; fire-standing regret wishing return; if returned would revert to forbidden confirmed liars
candidates.normLabel: cognitive barriers and irreversible regret: heart-coverings and ear-deafness prevent understanding even seeing every sign; legends-dismissal as tactic; self-destructive avoidance unrecognized; fire-standing regret wishing return; if returned would revert to forbidden confirmed liars
candidates.definition: In 6:25-28: Among them are those who listen but We placed coverings on their hearts lest they understand and in their ears deafness. If they see every sign they will not believe. When they come arguing they say this is legends of former peoples. They prevent others and avoid it destroying only themselves unawares. If you could see when standing before Fire saying would we could return not deny signs be believers. But appeared to them what they concealed. If returned they would return to forbidden; they are liars.

candidates.label: Worldly-play characterization and prophetic consolation: worldly life is play and diversion Hereafter better for righteous; We know your sadness they reject not you but Allah's signs; previous messengers patient until unalterable victory
candidates.normLabel: worldly-play characterization and prophetic consolation: worldly life is play and diversion hereafter better for righteous; we know your sadness they reject not you but allah's signs; previous messengers patient until unalterable victory
candidates.definition: In 6:32-34: The worldly life is nothing but play and diversion but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah so will you not reason? We know that what they say saddens you. They do not call you untruthful but the wrongdoers reject Allah's signs. Messengers were denied before you and were patient over denial and harm until Our victory came. None can alter Allah's words.

candidates.label: Creature-communities and crisis-invocation test: every creature bird communities like you nothing neglected in Register gathered to Lord; deniers deaf dumb in darknesses Allah guides or misguides; if punishment or Hour comes invoke other than Allah if truthful
candidates.normLabel: creature-communities and crisis-invocation test: every creature bird communities like you nothing neglected in register gathered to lord; deniers deaf dumb in darknesses allah guides or misguides; if punishment or hour comes invoke other than allah if truthful
candidates.definition: In 6:38-40: There is no creature on earth or bird flying with wings except communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register anything. Then to their Lord they will be gathered. Those who deny Our signs are deaf dumb in darknesses. Whomever Allah wills He misguides and whomever He wills He places on straight path. Say have you considered if punishment or Hour came would you invoke other than Allah if truthful?

candidates.label: Crisis-invocation sincerity and istidraj: Him alone invoked in distress removing affliction forgetting associates; forgotten reminder opens doors abundance then sudden seizure at rejoicing producing despair
candidates.normLabel: crisis-invocation sincerity and istidraj: him alone invoked in distress removing affliction forgetting associates; forgotten reminder opens doors abundance then sudden seizure at rejoicing producing despair
candidates.definition: In 6:41-44: It is Him alone you invoke and He removes that for which you invoked Him if He wills and you forget what you associate. So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded We opened to them the doors of everything until when they rejoiced in what they were given We seized them suddenly and they were in despair.

candidates.label: Sensory-deprivation hypothetical: if Allah took hearing sight sealed hearts which deity besides Allah could restore? sign-diversification met with persistent turning away
candidates.normLabel: sensory-deprivation hypothetical: if allah took hearing sight sealed hearts which deity besides allah could restore? sign-diversification met with persistent turning away
candidates.definition: In 6:46: Say have you considered if Allah should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts which deity other than Allah could bring them back to you? Look how We diversify the verses then they still turn away.

candidates.label: Messenger-function restriction: messengers sent only as glad-tidings-bearers and warners; belief-reformation yields freedom from fear grief; prophet disavows treasuries unseen-knowledge angel-status follows only revelation
candidates.normLabel: messenger-function restriction: messengers sent only as glad-tidings-bearers and warners; belief-reformation yields freedom from fear grief; prophet disavows treasuries unseen-knowledge angel-status follows only revelation
candidates.definition: In 6:48-50: We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. Whoever believes and reforms there will be no fear concerning them nor will they grieve. He takes your souls by night and knows what you committed by day then revives you therein that a specified term may be fulfilled then to Him is your return then He will inform you about what you used to do.

It will have besides Allah no protector nor intercessor. If it offered every compensation it would not be accepted. Those are given up for what they earned. For them is a drink of scalding water and painful punishment because they disbelieved.

candidates.definition: In 6:74-79: When Ibrahim said to his father Azar do you take idols as deities? I see you and your people in manifest error. Thus We showed Ibrahim the realm of heavens and earth that he would be among the certain. When night covered him he saw a star said this is my lord; when it set said I love not those that set. When he saw moon rising said this is my lord; when it set said unless my Lord guides me I will be among astray. When he saw sun rising said this is my lord this is greater; when it set said O my people I am free from what you associate. I have turned my face toward He who originated heavens and earth as hanif and I am not of the polytheists.

candidates.normLabel: prophetic lineage and continuous guidance-chain: eighteen prophets enumerated across generations from nuh to isa; hujjah given ibrahim; chose guided straight path; if associated would void deeds; scripture wisdom prophethood entrusted non-disbelieving successors

And Ismail Alyasa Yunus Lut each We preferred over the worlds. From their fathers offspring brothers We chose and guided to straight path. If they had associated it would have been voided for them. Those We gave scripture wisdom prophethood. If these disbelieve We entrusted it to people not disbelieving.

And you have certainly come to Us alone as We created you the first time and you have left whatever We bestowed upon you behind you. And We do not see with you your intercessors which you claimed. It has been severed between you and lost from you is what you used to claim.

He placed stars to guide through darknesses of land and sea. Produced you from one soul with dwelling and storage. Sent down water from sky produced growth of all things greenery grains arranged palm clusters gardens of grapevines olives pomegranates similar yet varied. Look at its fruit when it yields and ripening. Indeed in that are signs for people who believe. They attributed partners jinn while He created them fabricated sons daughters without knowledge.
