candidates.label: cand-0334: Topic from 7:59
candidates.definition: In 7:59: We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day

candidates.label: cand-0335: Topic from 7:63
candidates.definition: In 7:63: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you and that you may fear Allah so you might receive mercy

candidates.label: cand-0336: Topic from 7:66
candidates.definition: In 7:66: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "Indeed, we see you in foolishness, and indeed, we think you are of the liars

candidates.label: cand-0337: Topic from 7:71
candidates.definition: In 7:71: [Hud] said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allah has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait

candidates.label: cand-0338: Topic from 7:74
candidates.definition: In 7:74: And remember when He made you successors after the 'Aad and settled you in the land, [and] you take for yourselves palaces from its plains and carve from the mountains, homes. Then remember the favors of Allah and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

candidates.label: cand-0339: Topic from 7:78
candidates.definition: In 7:78: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone

candidates.label: cand-0340: Topic from 7:82
candidates.definition: In 7:82: But the answer of his people was only that they said, "Evict them from your city! Indeed, they are men who keep themselves pure

candidates.label: cand-0341: Topic from 7:86
candidates.definition: In 7:86: And do not sit on every path, threatening and averting from the way of Allah those who believe in Him, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. And remember when you were few and He increased you. And see how was the end of the corrupters

candidates.label: cand-0342: Topic from 7:90
candidates.definition: In 7:90: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "If you should follow Shu'ayb, indeed, you would then be losers

candidates.label: cand-0343: Topic from 7:94
candidates.definition: In 7:94: And We sent to no city a prophet [who was denied] except that We seized its people with poverty and hardship that they might humble themselves [to Allah]

candidates.label: cand-0344: Topic from 7:98
candidates.definition: In 7:98: Or did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them in the morning while they were at play

candidates.label: cand-0345: Topic from 7:102
candidates.definition: In 7:102: And We did not find for most of them any covenant; but indeed, We found most of them defiantly disobedient

candidates.label: cand-0346: Topic from 7:106
candidates.definition: In 7:106: [Pharaoh] said, "If you have come with a sign, then bring it forth, if you should be of the truthful

candidates.label: cand-0347: Topic from 7:111
candidates.definition: In 7:111: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

candidates.label: cand-0348: Topic from 7:114
candidates.definition: In 7:114: He said, "Yes, and, [moreover], you will be among those made near [to me]

candidates.label: cand-0349: Topic from 7:117
candidates.definition: In 7:117: And We inspired to Moses, "Throw your staff," and at once it devoured what they were falsifying

candidates.label: cand-0350: Topic from 7:121
candidates.definition: In 7:121: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds

candidates.label: cand-0351: Topic from 7:124
candidates.definition: In 7:124: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all

candidates.label: cand-0352: Topic from 7:128
candidates.definition: In 7:128: Said Moses to his people, "Seek help through Allah and be patient. Indeed, the earth belongs to Allah. He causes to inherit it whom He wills of His servants. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous

candidates.label: cand-0353: Topic from 7:131
candidates.definition: In 7:131: But when good came to them, they said, "This is ours [by right]." And if a bad [condition] struck them, they saw an evil omen in Moses and those with him. Unquestionably, their fortune is with Allah, but most of them do not know

candidates.label: cand-0354: Topic from 7:134
candidates.definition: In 7:134: And when the punishment descended upon them, they said, "O Moses, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. If you [can] remove the punishment from us, we will surely believe you, and we will send with you the Children of Israel

candidates.label: cand-0355: Topic from 7:138
candidates.definition: In 7:138: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea; then they came upon a people intent in devotion to [some] idols of theirs. They said, "O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods." He said, "Indeed, you are a people behaving ignorantly

candidates.label: cand-0356: Topic from 7:141
candidates.definition: In 7:141: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, [who were] afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord

candidates.label: cand-0357: Topic from 7:146
candidates.definition: In 7:146: I will turn away from My signs those who are arrogant upon the earth without right; and if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. And if they see the way of consciousness, they will not adopt it as a way; but if they see the way of error, they will adopt it as a way. That is because they have denied Our signs and they were heedless of them

candidates.label: cand-0358: Topic from 7:148
candidates.definition: In 7:148: And the people of Moses made, after [his departure], from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? They took it [for worship], and they were wrongdoers

candidates.label: cand-0359: Topic from 7:151
candidates.definition: In 7:151: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful

candidates.label: cand-0360: Topic from 7:154
candidates.definition: In 7:154: And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord

candidates.label: cand-0361: Topic from 7:157
candidates.definition: In 7:157: Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered prophet, whom they find written in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel, who enjoins upon them what is right and forbids them what is wrong and makes lawful for them the good things and prohibits for them the evil and relieves them of their burden and the shackles which were upon them. So they who have believed in him, honored him, supported him and followed the light which was sent down with him - it is those who will be the successful

candidates.label: cand-0362: Topic from 7:160
candidates.definition: In 7:160: And We divided them into twelve descendant tribes [as distinct] nations. And We inspired to Moses when his people implored him for water, "Strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs. Every people knew its watering place. And We shaded them with clouds and sent down upon them manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not, but they were [only] wronging themselves

candidates.label: cand-0363: Topic from 7:163
candidates.definition: In 7:163: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient

candidates.label: cand-0364: Topic from 7:166
candidates.definition: In 7:166: So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised

candidates.label: cand-0365: Topic from 7:169
candidates.definition: In 7:169: And there followed them successors who inherited the Scripture [while] taking the commodities of this lower life and saying, "It will be forgiven for us." And if an offer like it comes to them, they will [again] take it. Was not the covenant of the Scripture taken from them that they would not say about Allah except the truth, and they studied what was in it? And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah, so will you not use reason

candidates.label: cand-0366: Topic from 7:172
candidates.definition: In 7:172: And [mention] when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants and made them testify of themselves, [saying to them], "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes, we have testified." [This] - lest you should say on the day of Resurrection, "Indeed, we were of this unaware

candidates.label: cand-0367: Topic from 7:176
candidates.definition: In 7:176: And if We had willed, we could have elevated him thereby, but he adhered [instead] to the earth and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he [still] pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs. So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought

candidates.label: cand-0368: Topic from 7:179
candidates.definition: In 7:179: And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray. It is they who are the heedless

candidates.label: cand-0369: Topic from 7:182
candidates.definition: In 7:182: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know

candidates.label: cand-0370: Topic from 7:185
candidates.definition: In 7:185: Do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that Allah has created and [think] that perhaps their appointed time has come near? So in what statement hereafter will they believe

candidates.label: cand-0371: Topic from 7:188
candidates.definition: In 7:188: Say, "I hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what Allah has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe

candidates.label: cand-0372: Topic from 7:191
candidates.definition: In 7:191: Do they associate with Him those who create nothing and they are [themselves] created

candidates.label: cand-0373: Topic from 7:194
candidates.definition: In 7:194: Indeed, those you [polytheists] call upon besides Allah are servants like you. So call upon them and let them respond to you, if you should be truthful

candidates.label: cand-0374: Topic from 7:197
candidates.definition: In 7:197: And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves

candidates.label: cand-0375: Topic from 7:200
candidates.definition: In 7:200: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing

candidates.label: cand-0376: Topic from 7:203
candidates.definition: In 7:203: And when you, [O Muhammad], do not bring them a sign, they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This [Qur'an] is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

candidates.label: True believer definition: hearts tremble at Allah mention; verses increase faith; reliance on Lord; establish prayer; spend from provision; these are believers truly with degrees forgiveness noble provision
candidates.normLabel: true believer definition: hearts tremble at allah mention; verses increase faith; reliance on lord; establish prayer; spend from provision; these are believers truly with degrees forgiveness noble provision
candidates.definition: In 8:2-4: The believers are only those whose hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned and when His verses are recited it increases them in faith and upon their Lord they rely. Those who establish prayer and from what We provided them they spend. Those are the believers truly for them are degrees with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision.

candidates.label: Divine agency in combat: you did not kill them Allah killed them; you threw not when threw Allah threw; good test for believers; SameeAA Aleem
candidates.normLabel: divine agency in combat: you did not kill them allah killed them; you threw not when threw allah threw; good test for believers; sameeaa aleem
candidates.definition: In 8:17: You did not kill them but Allah killed them. You threw not when you threw but Allah threw that He might test the believers with a good test. Indeed Allah is Hearing Knowing.

candidates.label: Fitnah warning: trial will not exclusively strike wrongdoers; collective responsibility principle; severe penalty reminder
candidates.normLabel: fitnah warning: trial will not exclusively strike wrongdoers; collective responsibility principle; severe penalty reminder
candidates.definition: In 8:25: Fear a trial which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively and know that Allah is severe in penalty.

candidates.label: Furqan through taqwa: fearing Allah produces criterion removing misdeeds granting forgiveness; Allah possessor of great bounty
candidates.normLabel: furqan through taqwa: fearing allah produces criterion removing misdeeds granting forgiveness; allah possessor of great bounty
candidates.definition: In 8:29: O believers if you fear Allah He will grant you a criterion and remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allah is possessor of great bounty.

candidates.label: Divine makr superiority: disbelievers plot restrain kill evict; they plan Allah plans; Allah best of planners
candidates.normLabel: divine makr superiority: disbelievers plot restrain kill evict; they plan allah plans; allah best of planners
candidates.definition: In 8:30: When those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain or kill or evict you. They plan and Allah plans and Allah is best of planners.

candidates.label: Masjid al-Haram guardianship restricted to muttaqoon: obstruction justifies punishment; Qurayshi custodianship invalidated; most do not know
candidates.normLabel: masjid al-haram guardianship restricted to muttaqoon: obstruction justifies punishment; qurayshi custodianship invalidated; most do not know
candidates.definition: In 8:34: Why should Allah not punish them while they obstruct from al-Masjid al-Haram and they were not its guardians? Its guardians are only the muttaqoon but most of them do not know.

candidates.label: Khums five-way distribution: one-fifth of booty for Allah Messenger relatives orphans needy traveler; conditioned on belief in Allah and Furqan-day revelation
candidates.normLabel: khums five-way distribution: one-fifth of booty for allah messenger relatives orphans needy traveler; conditioned on belief in allah and furqan-day revelation
candidates.definition: In 8:41: Know that whatever booty you obtain then for Allah is one-fifth and for the Messenger and near relatives and orphans and needy and traveler if you have believed in Allah and what We sent down to Our Servant on day of Furqan day two armies met. And Allah over all things is Capable.

candidates.label: Blessing-change principle: Allah does not alter favor bestowed on people until they alter what is within themselves; SameeAA Aleem
candidates.normLabel: blessing-change principle: allah does not alter favor bestowed on people until they alter what is within themselves; sameeaa aleem
candidates.definition: In 8:53: That is because Allah would not change a favor He bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed Allah is Hearing Knowing.

candidates.label: Heart unification as exclusive divine act: spent all earth could not unite hearts; Allah united them; Azeez Hakeem
candidates.normLabel: heart unification as exclusive divine act: spent all earth could not unite hearts; allah united them; azeez hakeem
candidates.definition: In 8:63: And He brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth you could not have brought their hearts together but Allah brought them together. Indeed He is Exalted Mighty Wise.

candidates.label: Combat ratio adjustment: initial 1:10 for twenty steadfast; lightened to 1:2 recognizing weakness; bi-idhni Allah; Allah with sabireen
candidates.normLabel: combat ratio adjustment: initial 1:10 for twenty steadfast; lightened to 1:2 recognizing weakness; bi-idhni allah; allah with sabireen
candidates.definition: In 8:65-66: O Prophet urge believers to battle. If twenty steadfast overcome two hundred if hundred overcome thousand of disbelievers because they do not understand. Now Allah lightened for you knowing weakness in you so hundred steadfast overcome two hundred thousand overcome two thousand by Allah's permission. Allah is with the patient.

candidates.label: Prisoner ethics: prophet should not take captives before ithkhan; worldly desire critiqued; preceding kitab prevented punishment; booty halal tayyib with taqwa
candidates.normLabel: prisoner ethics: prophet should not take captives before ithkhan; worldly desire critiqued; preceding kitab prevented punishment; booty halal tayyib with taqwa
candidates.definition: In 8:67-69: Not for a prophet to have captives until he inflicts massacre in land. You desire world commodities Allah desires Hereafter. If not for preceding book from Allah great punishment would have touched you for what you took. So consume what you obtained lawful good and fear Allah. Indeed Allah is Forgiving Merciful.

candidates.label: Walayah-migration framework: believer solidarity defined by iman-hijrah-jihad plus shelter-aid; non-emigrants excluded until migration; religious aid obligation except treaty-partners; blood kinship priority in Kitab Allah
candidates.normLabel: walayah-migration framework: believer solidarity defined by iman-hijrah-jihad plus shelter-aid; non-emigrants excluded until migration; religious aid obligation except treaty-partners; blood kinship priority in kitab allah
candidates.definition: In 8:72-75: Those who believed emigrated fought with wealth and selves and those who sheltered aided are allies of one another. Those who believed but did not emigrate you have no walayah with them until they emigrate. If they seek help in religion you must help except against treaty-people. Disbelievers are allies of one another unless you do so fitnah and great corruption. Those who believed emigrated fought sheltered aided are truly believers with forgiveness noble provision. Those who believed after emigrated fought with you are of you. Blood relatives are more entitled in Book of Allah. Indeed Allah is Knowing of all things.

candidates.label: Satan's false protection abandoned: adorned deeds claimed invincibility and guardianship; fled at confrontation disassociated citing fear of Allah; severe penalty
candidates.normLabel: satan's false protection abandoned: adorned deeds claimed invincibility and guardianship; fled at confrontation disassociated citing fear of allah; severe penalty
candidates.definition: In 8:48: When Satan adorned their deeds and said no one overcomes you today I am your protector. When two armies sighted each other he turned on heels said I am disassociated from you I see what you do not see I fear Allah and Allah is severe in penalty.

candidates.label: Peace inclination reciprocity: if enemy inclines peace incline to it; rely on Allah; SameeAA Aleem
candidates.normLabel: peace inclination reciprocity: if enemy inclines peace incline to it; rely on allah; sameeaa aleem
candidates.definition: In 8:61: If they incline to peace then incline to it and rely upon Allah. Indeed He is the Hearing the Knowing.

candidates.label: Treaty betrayal management: chronic breakers identified as worst creatures; war dominance as deterrent dispersal; anticipated betrayal met with equal notification; Allah loves not traitors
candidates.normLabel: treaty betrayal management: chronic breakers identified as worst creatures; war dominance as deterrent dispersal; anticipated betrayal met with equal notification; allah loves not traitors
candidates.definition: In 8:55-58: Worst creatures at Allah are those who disbelieved they will not believe. Those you made treaty with then break pledge every time not fearing. If you dominate them in war disperse by them those behind perhaps they remember. If you fear betrayal throw back to them equally. Indeed Allah does not love traitors.

candidates.label: Military preparedness doctrine: prepare power and war-steeds to terrify Allah's enemy your enemy unknown others; spending fully repaid without injustice
candidates.normLabel: military preparedness doctrine: prepare power and war-steeds to terrify allah's enemy your enemy unknown others; spending fully repaid without injustice
candidates.definition: In 8:60: Prepare against them whatever power and war-steeds you can to terrify enemy of Allah and your enemy and others besides them you do not know Allah knows them. Whatever you spend in Allah's way will be fully repaid and you will not be wronged.

candidates.label: Captive rehabilitation pathway: address prisoners promising better replacement for taken wealth plus forgiveness if hearts contain good; Ghafoor Raheem
candidates.normLabel: captive rehabilitation pathway: address prisoners promising better replacement for taken wealth plus forgiveness if hearts contain good; ghafoor raheem
candidates.definition: In 8:70: O Prophet say to captives in your hands if Allah knows good in your hearts He will give you better than what was taken and forgive you. And Allah is Forgiving Merciful.

candidates.label: Pagan prayer at Kaaba characterized as whistling and hand-clapping: ritual reduced to noise-performance; taste punishment for disbelief
candidates.normLabel: pagan prayer at kaaba characterized as whistling and hand-clapping: ritual reduced to noise-performance; taste punishment for disbelief
candidates.definition: In 8:35: Their prayer at the House was nothing but whistling and hand-clapping. So taste punishment for what you disbelieved.

candidates.label: Angelic soul-taking violence: angels strike faces and backs of dying disbelievers; taste burning fire; justified by hands' deeds; Allah not unjust
candidates.normLabel: angelic soul-taking violence: angels strike faces and backs of dying disbelievers; taste burning fire; justified by hands' deeds; allah not unjust
candidates.definition: In 8:50-51: If you could see when angels take souls of disbelievers striking their faces and backs: taste punishment of burning fire. That is for what your hands sent forth and Allah is not ever unjust to servants.

candidates.label: Challenge prayer for punishment: disbelievers demanded stones from sky or painful punishment; dual immunity through Prophet presence and istighfar
candidates.normLabel: challenge prayer for punishment: disbelievers demanded stones from sky or painful punishment; dual immunity through prophet presence and istighfar
candidates.definition: In 8:32-33: When they said O Allah if this is truth from You rain stones from sky or bring painful punishment. But Allah would not punish them while you are among them nor while they seek forgiveness.

candidates.label: cand-0407: Topic from 9:1
candidates.definition: In 9:1: [This is a declaration of] disassociation, from Allah and His Messenger, to those with whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists

candidates.label: cand-0408: Topic from 9:4
candidates.definition: In 9:4: Excepted are those with whom you made a treaty among the polytheists and then they have not been deficient toward you in anything or supported anyone against you; so complete for them their treaty until their term [has ended]. Indeed, Allah loves the righteous [who fear Him]

candidates.label: cand-0409: Topic from 9:7
candidates.definition: In 9:7: How can there be for the polytheists a treaty in the sight of Allah and with His Messenger, except for those with whom you made a treaty at al-Masjid al-Haram? So as long as they are upright toward you, be upright toward them. Indeed, Allah loves the righteous [who fear Him]

candidates.label: cand-0410: Topic from 9:10
candidates.definition: In 9:10: They do not observe toward a believer any pact of kinship or covenant of protection. And it is they who are the transgressors

candidates.label: cand-0411: Topic from 9:13
candidates.definition: In 9:13: Would you not fight a people who broke their oaths and determined to expel the Messenger, and they had begun [the attack upon] you the first time? Do you fear them? But Allah has more right that you should fear Him, if you are [truly] believers

candidates.label: cand-0412: Topic from 9:17
candidates.definition: In 9:17: It is not for the polytheists to maintain the mosques of Allah [while] witnessing against themselves with disbelief. [For] those, their deeds have become worthless, and in the Fire they will abide eternally

candidates.label: cand-0413: Topic from 9:20
candidates.definition: In 9:20: The ones who have believed, emigrated and striven in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives are greater in rank in the sight of Allah. And it is those who are the attainers [of success]

candidates.label: cand-0414: Topic from 9:23
candidates.definition: In 9:23: O you who have believed, do not take your fathers or your brothers as allies if they have preferred disbelief over belief. And whoever does so among you - then it is those who are the wrongdoers

candidates.label: cand-0415: Topic from 9:26
candidates.definition: In 9:26: Then Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and sent down soldiers angels whom you did not see and punished those who disbelieved. And that is the recompense of the disbelievers

candidates.label: cand-0416: Topic from 9:29
candidates.definition: In 9:29: Fight those who do not believe in Allah or in the Last Day and who do not consider unlawful what Allah and His Messenger have made unlawful and who do not adopt the religion of truth from those who were given the Scripture - [fight] until they give the jizyah willingly while they are humbled

candidates.label: cand-0417: Topic from 9:34
candidates.definition: In 9:34: O you who have believed, indeed many of the scholars and the monks devour the wealth of people unjustly and avert [them] from the way of Allah. And those who hoard gold and silver and spend it not in the way of Allah - give them tidings of a painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-0418: Topic from 9:37
candidates.definition: In 9:37: Indeed, the postponing [of restriction within sacred months] is an increase in disbelief by which those who have disbelieved are led [further] astray. They make it lawful one year and unlawful another year to correspond to the number made unlawful by Allah and [thus] make lawful what Allah has made unlawful. Made pleasing to them is the evil of their deeds; and Allah does not guide the disbelieving people

candidates.label: cand-0419: Topic from 9:40
candidates.definition: In 9:40: If you do not aid the Prophet - Allah has already aided him when those who disbelieved had driven him out [of Makkah] as one of two, when they were in the cave and he said to his companion, "Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us." And Allah sent down his tranquillity upon him and supported him with angels you did not see and made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, while the word of Allah - that is the highest. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

candidates.label: cand-0420: Topic from 9:43
candidates.definition: In 9:43: May Allah pardon you, [O Muhammad]; why did you give them permission [to remain behind]? [You should not have] until it was evident to you who were truthful and you knew [who were] the liars

candidates.label: cand-0421: Topic from 9:46
candidates.definition: In 9:46: And if they had intended to go forth, they would have prepared for it [some] preparation. But Allah disliked their being sent, so He kept them back, and they were told, "Remain [behind] with those who remain

candidates.label: cand-0422: Topic from 9:50
candidates.definition: In 9:50: If good befalls you, it distresses them; but if disaster strikes you, they say, "We took our matter [in hand] before," and turn away while they are rejoicing

candidates.label: cand-0423: Topic from 9:53
candidates.definition: In 9:53: Say, "Spend willingly or unwillingly; never will it be accepted from you. Indeed, you have been a defiantly disobedient people

candidates.label: cand-0424: Topic from 9:56
candidates.definition: In 9:56: And they swear by Allah that they are from among you while they are not from among you; but they are a people who are afraid

candidates.label: cand-0425: Topic from 9:59
candidates.definition: In 9:59: If only they had been satisfied with what Allah and His Messenger gave them and said, "Sufficient for us is Allah; Allah will give us of His bounty, and [so will] His Messenger; indeed, we are desirous toward Allah," [it would have been better for them]

candidates.label: cand-0426: Topic from 9:62
candidates.definition: In 9:62: They swear by Allah to you [Muslims] to satisfy you. But Allah and His Messenger are more worthy for them to satisfy, if they should be believers

candidates.label: cand-0427: Topic from 9:67
candidates.definition: In 9:67: The hypocrite men and hypocrite women are of one another. They enjoin what is wrong and forbid what is right and close their hands. They have forgotten Allah, so He has forgotten them [accordingly]. Indeed, the hypocrites - it is they who are the defiantly disobedient

candidates.label: cand-0428: Topic from 9:70
candidates.definition: In 9:70: Has there not reached them the news of those before them - the people of Noah and [the tribes of] 'Aad and Thamud and the people of Abraham and the companions of Madyan and the towns overturned? Their messengers came to them with clear proofs. And Allah would never have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves

candidates.label: cand-0429: Topic from 9:73
candidates.definition: In 9:73: O Prophet, fight against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination

candidates.label: cand-0430: Topic from 9:76
candidates.definition: In 9:76: But when he gave them from His bounty, they were stingy with it and turned away while they refused

candidates.label: cand-0431: Topic from 9:79
candidates.definition: In 9:79: Those who criticize the contributors among the believers concerning [their] charities and [criticize] the ones who find nothing [to spend] except their effort, so they ridicule them - Allah will ridicule them, and they will have a painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-0432: Topic from 9:83
candidates.definition: In 9:83: If Allah should return you to a faction of them [after the expedition] and then they ask your permission to go out [to battle], say, "You will not go out with me, ever, and you will never fight with me an enemy. Indeed, you were satisfied with sitting [at home] the first time, so sit [now] with those who stay behind

candidates.label: cand-0436: Topic from 9:95

candidates.label: cand-0437: Topic from 9:100

That is the great attainment

candidates.label: cand-0438: Topic from 9:102

candidates.label: cand-0439: Topic from 9:105
candidates.definition: In 9:105: And say, "Do [as you will], for Allah will see your deeds, and [so, will] His Messenger and the believers. And you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you of what you used to do

candidates.label: cand-0440: Topic from 9:108
candidates.definition: In 9:108: Do not stand [for prayer] within it - ever. A mosque founded on righteousness from the first day is more worthy for you to stand in. Within it are men who love to purify themselves; and Allah loves those who purify themselves

candidates.label: cand-0441: Topic from 9:111
candidates.definition: In 9:111: Indeed, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties [in exchange] for that they will have Paradise. They fight in the cause of Allah, so they kill and are killed. [It is] a true promise [binding] upon Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur'an. And who is truer to his covenant than Allah? So rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. And it is that which is the great attainment

candidates.label: cand-0442: Topic from 9:114

candidates.label: cand-0443: Topic from 9:117

candidates.label: cand-0444: Topic from 9:120
candidates.definition: In 9:120: It was not [proper] for the people of Madinah and those surrounding them of the bedouins that they remain behind after [the departure of] the Messenger of Allah or that they prefer themselves over his self. That is because they are not afflicted by thirst or fatigue or hunger in the cause of Allah, nor do they tread on any ground that enrages the disbelievers, nor do they inflict upon an enemy any infliction but that is registered for them as a righteous deed. Indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of the doers of good

candidates.label: cand-0445: Topic from 9:123
candidates.definition: In 9:123: O you who have believed, fight those adjacent to you of the disbelievers and let them find in you harshness. And know that Allah is with the righteous

candidates.label: cand-0446: Topic from 9:126
candidates.definition: In 9:126: Do they not see that they are tried every year once or twice but then they do not repent nor do they remember

candidates.label: cand-0447: Topic from 10:1
candidates.definition: In 10:1: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the wise Book

candidates.label: cand-0448: Topic from 10:3
candidates.definition: In 10:3: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne, arranging the matter [of His creation]. candidates.label: cand-0449: Topic from 10:6
candidates.definition: In 10:6: Indeed, in the alternation of the night and the day and [in] what Allah has created in the heavens and the earth are signs for a people who fear Allah

candidates.label: cand-0450: Topic from 10:9
candidates.definition: In 10:9: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - their Lord will guide them because of their faith. Beneath them rivers will flow in the Gardens of Pleasure

candidates.label: cand-0451: Topic from 10:11
candidates.definition: In 10:11: And if Allah was to hasten for the people the evil [they invoke] as He hastens for them the good, their term would have been ended for them. But We leave the ones who do not expect the meeting with Us, in their transgression, wandering blindly

candidates.label: cand-0452: Topic from 10:14
candidates.definition: In 10:14: Then We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do

candidates.label: cand-0453: Topic from 10:17

candidates.label: cand-0454: Topic from 10:19
candidates.definition: In 10:19: And mankind was not but one community [united in religion], but [then] they differed. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them [immediately] concerning that over which they differ

candidates.label: cand-0455: Topic from 10:22
candidates.definition: In 10:22: It is He who enables you to travel on land and sea until, when you are in ships and they sail with them by a good wind and they rejoice therein, there comes a storm wind and the waves come upon them from everywhere and they assume that they are surrounded, supplicating Allah, sincere to Him in religion, "If You should save us from this, we will surely be among the thankful

candidates.label: cand-0456: Topic from 10:25
candidates.definition: In 10:25: And Allah invites to the Home of Peace and guides whom He wills to a straight path

candidates.label: cand-0457: Topic from 10:29
candidates.definition: In 10:29: And sufficient is Allah as a witness between us and you that we were of your worship unaware

candidates.label: cand-0458: Topic from 10:31

candidates.label: cand-0459: Topic from 10:34
candidates.definition: In 10:34: Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who begins creation and then repeats it?" Say, "Allah begins creation and then repeats it, so how are you deluded

candidates.label: cand-0460: Topic from 10:37
candidates.definition: In 10:37: And it was not [possible] for this Qur'an to be produced by other than Allah, but [it is] a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the [former] Scripture, about which there is no doubt, from the Lord of the worlds

candidates.label: cand-0461: Topic from 10:39
candidates.definition: In 10:39: Rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers

candidates.label: cand-0462: Topic from 10:42
candidates.definition: In 10:42: And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear, although they will not use reason

candidates.label: cand-0463: Topic from 10:45

candidates.label: cand-0464: Topic from 10:47

candidates.label: cand-0465: Topic from 10:50
candidates.definition: In 10:50: Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient

candidates.label: cand-0466: Topic from 10:53
candidates.definition: In 10:53: And they ask information of you, [O Muhammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allah]

candidates.label: cand-0467: Topic from 10:57
candidates.definition: In 10:57: O mankind, there has to come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers

candidates.label: cand-0468: Topic from 10:59
candidates.definition: In 10:59: Say, "Have you seen what Allah has sent down to you of provision of which you have made [some] lawful and [some] unlawful?" Say, "Has Allah permitted you [to do so], or do you invent [something] about Allah

candidates.label: cand-0469: Topic from 10:62
candidates.definition: In 10:62: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

candidates.definition: In 10:65: And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allah entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing

candidates.label: cand-0471: Topic from 10:67
candidates.definition: In 10:67: It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen

candidates.definition: In 10:70: [For them is brief] enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return; then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve

candidates.label: cand-0473: Topic from 10:73
candidates.definition: In 10:73: And they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship and made them successors, and We drowned those who denied Our signs. Then see how was the end of those who were warned

candidates.definition: In 10:75: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people

candidates.definition: In 10:78: They said, "Have you come to us to turn us away from that upon which we found our fathers and so that you two may have grandeur in the land? And we are not believers in you

candidates.definition: In 10:81: And when they had thrown, Moses said, "What you have brought is [only] magic. Indeed, Allah will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allah does not amend the work of corrupters

candidates.definition: In 10:85: So they said, "Upon Allah do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people

candidates.definition: In 10:87: And We inspired to Moses and his brother, "Settle your people in Egypt in houses and make your houses [facing the] qiblah and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers

candidates.label: cand-0479: Topic from 10:89
candidates.definition: In 10:89: [Allah] said, "Your supplication has been answered." So remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know

candidates.definition: In 10:92: So today We will save you in body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign. And indeed, many among the people, of Our signs, are heedless

candidates.label: cand-0481: Topic from 10:94
candidates.definition: In 10:94: So if you are in doubt, [O Muhammad], about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters

candidates.label: cand-0482: Topic from 10:97
candidates.definition: In 10:97: Even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-0483: Topic from 10:99
candidates.definition: In 10:99: And had your Lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. Then, [O Muhammad], would you compel the people in order that they become believers

candidates.definition: In 10:104: Say, [O Muhammad], "O people, if you are in doubt as to my religion - then I do not worship those which you worship besides Allah; but I worship Allah, who causes your death. And I have been commanded to be of the believers

candidates.definition: In 10:106: And do not invoke besides Allah that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers

candidates.label: Perfected-detailed Book: Quran described as uhkimat ayatuhu thumma fussilat from Hakeem Khabeer establishing dual quality of precision and elaboration

candidates.definition: In 11:1: Alif Lam Ra. A Book whose verses are perfected then detailed from One Wise Acquainted.

candidates.normLabel: istighfar-provision linkage: seeking forgiveness and repentance yields good temporal provision and favor distribution connecting spiritual practice to material well-being
candidates.definition: In 11:3: Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him. He will let you enjoy good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor.

candidates.label: Human psychological volatility: mercy withdrawal produces despair-ingratitude while favor after hardship produces boastful exultation revealing fortune-dependent faith instability
candidates.normLabel: human psychological volatility: mercy withdrawal produces despair-ingratitude while favor after hardship produces boastful exultation revealing fortune-dependent faith instability

candidates.normLabel: ten-surah challenge: falsification criterion demanding production of ten invented surahs calling upon anyone besides allah proving quran's divine origin through non-response
candidates.definition: In 11:13-14: Say bring ten surahs like it invented and call whomever you can besides Allah if truthful. If they do not respond know it was revealed with Allah's knowledge.

candidates.label: Worldly-desire seekers fully repaid here: those wanting dunya life and adornment receive complete compensation without deprivation but Fire alone in Hereafter with worthless deeds
candidates.normLabel: worldly-desire seekers fully repaid here: those wanting dunya life and adornment receive complete compensation without deprivation but fire alone in hereafter with worthless deeds
candidates.definition: In 11:15-16: Whoever desires worldly life We fully repay their deeds therein not deprived. Those have only Fire in Hereafter; lost what they made worthless what they did.

candidates.label: Clear-evidence believer with divine witness: person on bayyinah from Lord with shahid minhu and Musa's Book as imam-mercy believes in Quran establishing multi-source verification
candidates.normLabel: clear-evidence believer with divine witness: person on bayyinah from lord with shahid minhu and musa's book as imam-mercy believes in quran establishing multi-source verification
candidates.definition: In 11:17: Is one on clear evidence from Lord followed by witness from Him and before it Musa's Book as leader and mercy? Those believe in it.

candidates.normLabel: supreme injustice of fabricating lies against allah: inventing falsehood about god as worst wrongdoing with public exposure before lord and witness testimony confirming lying
candidates.definition: In 11:18: Who is more unjust than one who invents lie about Allah? Those presented before Lord witnesses say these lied against Lord. Curse of Allah on wrongdoers.

candidates.label: Two-party parable: blind-deaf versus seeing-hearing as fundamental epistemological divide illustrating irreducible inequality between disbelief and faith
candidates.normLabel: two-party parable: blind-deaf versus seeing-hearing as fundamental epistemological divide illustrating irreducible inequality between disbelief and faith
candidates.definition: In 11:24: Example of two parties like blind-deaf and seeing-hearing. Are they equal? Will you not remember?

candidates.normLabel: universal creature provision doctrine: every dabbah on earth has rizq guaranteed by allah who knows mustaqarr and mustawda' all recorded in kitab mubeen
candidates.definition: In 11:6: No creature on earth but upon Allah is its provision. He knows its dwelling and storage. All in clear register.

candidates.normLabel: creation as test of best conduct: six-day creation with throne on water explicitly purposed to test which person is best in deed establishing existence as examination
candidates.definition: In 11:7: He created heavens earth in six days His Throne on water to test you which is best in deed.

candidates.normLabel: elite social-status rejection: dismissing prophet as mere man followed by lowest social class (arathiluna badiya al-rrayi) revealing class-based epistemological barrier

candidates.normLabel: prophetic disavowal template: nuh denies possessing treasuries unseen-knowledge or angelhood affirming pure messenger function limited to conveyed revelation
candidates.definition: In 11:31: I do not say I have Allah's treasuries or know unseen or am angel. Allah knows best what is in their souls.

candidates.label: Believer protection principle: refusing to expel low-status believers because they will meet their Lord establishing divine accountability as social-equality guarantor
candidates.normLabel: believer protection principle: refusing to expel low-status believers because they will meet their lord establishing divine accountability as social-equality guarantor
candidates.definition: In 11:29-30: I am not driving away believers; they will meet their Lord. Who would protect me from Allah if I drove them away?

candidates.normLabel: ship construction under divine observation: building bi-a'yunina wawahyina establishing continuous supervision and inspiration during obedient labor amid ridicule
candidates.definition: In 11:37: Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration. Do not address Me concerning wrongdoers; they are drowned.

candidates.label: Father-son separation by faith: Nuh's son refuses boarding seeking mountain refuge; waves separate them; divine correction redefines family by righteousness not blood
candidates.normLabel: father-son separation by faith: nuh's son refuses boarding seeking mountain refuge; waves separate them; divine correction redefines family by righteousness not blood
candidates.definition: In 11:42-46: Son says I will take refuge on mountain. Nuh says no protector today except mercy. Waves separated them. Nuh appeals son is family. Allah says not of family; unrighteous work; do not ask without knowledge.

candidates.label: Disembarkation blessing with future warning: salam-barakat upon Nuh and nations from those with him; other nations enjoy then face painful punishment
candidates.normLabel: disembarkation blessing with future warning: salam-barakat upon nuh and nations from those with him; other nations enjoy then face painful punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:48: Disembark in peace from Us and blessings upon you and nations from those with you. Other nations We grant enjoyment then painful punishment touches them.

candidates.label: Hud's istighfar-rain-strength promise: seek forgiveness repent yields rain showers and added strength linking spiritual renewal to environmental and physical empowerment
candidates.normLabel: hud's istighfar-rain-strength promise: seek forgiveness repent yields rain showers and added strength linking spiritual renewal to environmental and physical empowerment
candidates.definition: In 11:52: O my people seek forgiveness of your Lord then repent. He will send sky rain in showers and increase you strength added to your strength.

candidates.normLabel: tawakkul with forelock-holding imagery: hud declares reliance on allah who holds every creature's forelock establishing total divine control metaphor
candidates.definition: In 11:56: I have relied upon Allah my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but He holds its forelock. My Lord is on straight path.

candidates.label: Ad's obstinate tyranny pattern: rejected signs disobeyed messengers followed every jabbar aneed establishing leadership-following as destruction mechanism
candidates.normLabel: ad's obstinate tyranny pattern: rejected signs disobeyed messengers followed every jabbar aneed establishing leadership-following as destruction mechanism
candidates.definition: In 11:59: That was Ad who rejected Lord's signs disobeyed His messengers followed command of every obstinate tyrant.

candidates.normLabel: double-world curse: ad followed by curse in this world and resurrection day establishing comprehensive consequences extending beyond temporal punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:60: They were followed in this world with curse and on Resurrection Day. Indeed Ad denied their Lord; away with Ad people of Hud.

candidates.label: She-camel as divine sign with harm prohibition: naqat Allah designated as ayah with feeding permission and touching-harm prohibition triggering timed punishment
candidates.normLabel: she-camel as divine sign with harm prohibition: naqat allah designated as ayah with feeding permission and touching-harm prohibition triggering timed punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:64-65: This she-camel of Allah is sign for you. Let her feed on Allah's earth. Do not touch with harm or impending punishment takes you. They hamstrung her.

candidates.label: Sayhah destruction pattern: shriek seizes wrongdoers leaving them prone in homes as if never prospered establishing sudden-total annihilation signature
candidates.normLabel: sayhah destruction pattern: shriek seizes wrongdoers leaving them prone in homes as if never prospered establishing sudden-total annihilation signature
candidates.definition: In 11:67-68: Shriek seized wrongdoers; they became prone in homes. As if never prospered. Thamud denied Lord; away with Thamud.

candidates.label: Ibrahim's hospitality model: immediate salam exchange roasted calf offering establishing prophetic hospitality standard with guest honor priority
candidates.normLabel: ibrahim's hospitality model: immediate salam exchange roasted calf offering establishing prophetic hospitality standard with guest honor priority
candidates.definition: In 11:69: Messengers came to Ibrahim with glad tidings. They said peace. He said peace. Did not delay bringing roasted calf.

candidates.label: Sarah's amazed laughter at old-age birth: human limitation confronted by divine creative power producing astonished joy mixed with incredulity
candidates.normLabel: sarah's amazed laughter at old-age birth: human limitation confronted by divine creative power producing astonished joy mixed with incredulity
candidates.definition: In 11:71-72: Wife standing smiled. Given glad tidings of Ishaq and Yaqub. She said woe to me shall I bear when old and husband old? Amazing thing!

candidates.label: Intercession boundary: Ibrahim's pleading for Lot halted by angels declaring Lord's command arrived punishment irrevocable establishing prophetic-intercession limits
candidates.normLabel: intercession boundary: ibrahim's pleading for lot halted by angels declaring lord's command arrived punishment irrevocable establishing prophetic-intercession limits
candidates.definition: In 11:74-76: After fright left and glad tidings came he argued concerning Lot. Angels said give up; Lord's command come; punishment cannot be repelled.

candidates.label: Lot's protective anguish for guests: host distress at community intentions offering daughters as purer alternative revealing extreme hospitality obligation
candidates.normLabel: lot's protective anguish for guests: host distress at community intentions offering daughters as purer alternative revealing extreme hospitality obligation
candidates.definition: In 11:77-79: Lot anguished felt discomfort said trying day. People hastening doing evil. He said these my daughters purer for you fear Allah do not disgrace me in guests.

candidates.label: City inversion and sijjeel stone rain: high-made-low with marked stones from Lord establishing distinctive punishment signature for Lut's people
candidates.normLabel: city inversion and sijjeel stone rain: high-made-low with marked stones from lord establishing distinctive punishment signature for lut's people
candidates.definition: In 11:82-83: When command came We made high low rained stones of layered hard clay marked from your Lord not far from wrongdoers.

candidates.label: Economic justice as prophetic mission: Shu'ayb combines tawheed with measure-weight fairness prohibiting deprivation and earth-corruption linking commerce to faith
candidates.normLabel: economic justice as prophetic mission: shu'ayb combines tawheed with measure-weight fairness prohibiting deprivation and earth-corruption linking commerce to faith
candidates.definition: In 11:84-85: Worship Allah no deity other Him. Do not decrease measure scale. Give full measure weight in justice. Do not deprive people things. Do not abuse earth corrupting.

candidates.label: Baqiyyat Allah concept: what remains lawful from Allah is best for believers linking honest remainder to faith condition as economic-spiritual principle
candidates.normLabel: baqiyyat allah concept: what remains lawful from allah is best for believers linking honest remainder to faith condition as economic-spiritual principle
candidates.definition: In 11:86: What remains from Allah is best for you if you are believers. I am not guardian over you.

candidates.label: Reform-intent declaration: Shu'ayb states only intending islaha as able with success only through Allah establishing prophetic methodology combining effort with tawakkul
candidates.normLabel: reform-intent declaration: shu'ayb states only intending islaha as able with success only through allah establishing prophetic methodology combining effort with tawakkul
candidates.definition: In 11:88: I only intend reform as much as I am able. My success is only through Allah. Upon Him I rely and to Him I return.

candidates.label: Leadership-to-Fire pattern: Firawn leads people into Fire on Resurrection demonstrating that following non-rashid leadership produces collective damnation
candidates.normLabel: leadership-to-fire pattern: firawn leads people into fire on resurrection demonstrating that following non-rashid leadership produces collective damnation
candidates.definition: In 11:97-98: They followed Firawn's command; not rashid. He precedes people on Resurrection leads them into Fire; wretched destination.

candidates.label: Self-wronging principle: Allah did not wrong destroyed communities; they wronged themselves; false gods availed nothing establishing divine justice in punishment
candidates.normLabel: self-wronging principle: allah did not wrong destroyed communities; they wronged themselves; false gods availed nothing establishing divine justice in punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:101: We did not wrong them but they wronged themselves. Their gods invoked besides Allah availed nothing when Lord's command came.

candidates.label: Shaqiyy-sa'eed duality with conditional eternity: wretched in Fire prosperous in Paradise both abiding while heavens earth endure except what Lord wills preserving divine sovereignty
candidates.normLabel: shaqiyy-sa'eed duality with conditional eternity: wretched in fire prosperous in paradise both abiding while heavens earth endure except what lord wills preserving divine sovereignty
candidates.definition: In 11:107-108: Wretched in Fire with exhaling inhaling abiding while heavens earth endure except Lord wills; Lord is Effecter of what He intends. Prosperous in Paradise abiding similarly; uninterrupted bestowal.

candidates.label: Istiqamah command: remain steadfast as commanded with those who turned with you; do not transgress; He is Seeing establishing perseverance-community-vigilance triad
candidates.normLabel: istiqamah command: remain steadfast as commanded with those who turned with you; do not transgress; he is seeing establishing perseverance-community-vigilance triad
candidates.definition: In 11:112: Remain steadfast as commanded, you and those who turned with you. Do not transgress. Indeed He is Seeing of what you do.

candidates.label: Anti-inclination to wrongdoers: do not lean toward oppressors lest Fire touch you; no protectors besides Allah; no help available establishing association-danger principle
candidates.normLabel: anti-inclination to wrongdoers: do not lean toward oppressors lest fire touch you; no protectors besides allah; no help available establishing association-danger principle
