candidates.definition: In 16:19: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare

candidates.label: cand-0644: Topic from 16:22
candidates.definition: In 16:22: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant

candidates.label: cand-0645: Topic from 16:25
candidates.definition: In 16:25: That they may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear

candidates.label: cand-0646: Topic from 16:28
candidates.definition: In 16:28: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do

candidates.label: cand-0647: Topic from 16:33
candidates.definition: In 16:33: Do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves

candidates.label: cand-0648: Topic from 16:36
candidates.definition: In 16:36: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers

candidates.label: cand-0649: Topic from 16:39
candidates.definition: In 16:39: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars

candidates.label: cand-0650: Topic from 16:42
candidates.definition: In 16:42: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied

candidates.label: cand-0651: Topic from 16:45
candidates.definition: In 16:45: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive

candidates.label: cand-0652: Topic from 16:48
candidates.definition: In 16:48: Have they not considered what things Allah has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah, while they are humble

candidates.label: cand-0653: Topic from 16:51
candidates.definition: In 16:51: And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He is but one God, so fear only Me

candidates.label: cand-0654: Topic from 16:54
candidates.definition: In 16:54: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord

candidates.label: cand-0655: Topic from 16:57
candidates.definition: In 16:57: And they attribute to Allah daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire

candidates.label: cand-0656: Topic from 16:60
candidates.definition: In 16:60: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-0657: Topic from 16:65
candidates.definition: In 16:65: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen

candidates.label: cand-0658: Topic from 16:68
candidates.definition: In 16:68: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct

candidates.label: cand-0659: Topic from 16:71
candidates.definition: In 16:71: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject

candidates.label: cand-0660: Topic from 16:74
candidates.definition: In 16:74: So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know

candidates.label: cand-0661: Topic from 16:77
candidates.definition: In 16:77: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent

candidates.label: cand-0662: Topic from 16:80
candidates.definition: In 16:80: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time

candidates.label: cand-0663: Topic from 16:83
candidates.definition: In 16:83: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers

candidates.label: cand-0664: Topic from 16:86
candidates.definition: In 16:86: And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say," Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars

candidates.label: cand-0665: Topic from 16:89
candidates.definition: In 16:89: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims

candidates.label: cand-0666: Topic from 16:92
candidates.definition: In 16:92: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ

candidates.label: cand-0667: Topic from 16:97
candidates.definition: In 16:97: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do

candidates.label: cand-0668: Topic from 16:100
candidates.definition: In 16:100: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allah

candidates.label: cand-0669: Topic from 16:103
candidates.definition: In 16:103: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches the Prophet." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this Qur'an is [in] a clear Arabic language

candidates.label: cand-0670: Topic from 16:106
candidates.definition: In 16:106: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah, and for them is a great punishment

candidates.label: cand-0671: Topic from 16:109
candidates.definition: In 16:109: Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers

candidates.label: cand-0672: Topic from 16:112
candidates.definition: In 16:112: And Allah presents an example: a city which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of Allah. So Allah made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing

candidates.label: cand-0673: Topic from 16:115
candidates.definition: In 16:115: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

candidates.label: cand-0674: Topic from 16:118
candidates.definition: In 16:118: And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before. And We did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves

candidates.label: cand-0675: Topic from 16:121
candidates.definition: In 16:121: [He was] grateful for His favors. Allah chose him and guided him to a straight path

candidates.label: cand-0676: Topic from 16:124
candidates.definition: In 16:124: The sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

candidates.label: cand-0677: Topic from 17:1
candidates.definition: In 17:1: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing

candidates.label: cand-0678: Topic from 17:3
candidates.definition: In 17:3: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant

candidates.label: cand-0679: Topic from 17:6
candidates.definition: In 17:6: Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower

candidates.label: cand-0680: Topic from 17:9
candidates.definition: In 17:9: Indeed, this Qur'an guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward

candidates.label: cand-0681: Topic from 17:11
candidates.definition: In 17:11: And man supplicates for evil as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty

candidates.label: cand-0682: Topic from 17:14
candidates.definition: In 17:14: [It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant

candidates.label: cand-0683: Topic from 17:17
candidates.definition: In 17:17: And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah. And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Acquainted and Seeing

candidates.label: cand-0684: Topic from 17:19
candidates.definition: In 17:19: But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allah]

candidates.label: cand-0685: Topic from 17:22
candidates.definition: In 17:22: Do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken

candidates.label: cand-0686: Topic from 17:25
candidates.definition: In 17:25: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving

candidates.label: cand-0687: Topic from 17:29
candidates.definition: In 17:29: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent

candidates.label: cand-0688: Topic from 17:31
candidates.definition: In 17:31: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin

candidates.label: cand-0689: Topic from 17:34
candidates.definition: In 17:34: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned

candidates.label: cand-0690: Topic from 17:37
candidates.definition: In 17:37: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height

candidates.label: cand-0691: Topic from 17:39
candidates.definition: In 17:39: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished

candidates.label: cand-0692: Topic from 17:42
candidates.definition: In 17:42: Say, [O Muhammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way

candidates.label: cand-0693: Topic from 17:45
candidates.definition: In 17:45: And when you recite the Qur'an, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition

candidates.label: cand-0694: Topic from 17:47
candidates.definition: In 17:47: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic

candidates.label: cand-0695: Topic from 17:50
candidates.definition: In 17:50: Say, "Be you stones or iron

candidates.label: cand-0696: Topic from 17:53
candidates.definition: In 17:53: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy

candidates.label: cand-0697: Topic from 17:57
candidates.definition: In 17:57: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared

candidates.label: cand-0698: Topic from 17:59
candidates.definition: In 17:59: And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning

candidates.label: cand-0699: Topic from 17:62
candidates.definition: In 17:62: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few

candidates.label: cand-0700: Topic from 17:65
candidates.definition: In 17:65: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs

candidates.label: cand-0701: Topic from 17:67
candidates.definition: In 17:67: And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful

candidates.label: cand-0702: Topic from 17:70
candidates.definition: In 17:70: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference

candidates.label: cand-0703: Topic from 17:73
candidates.definition: In 17:73: And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend

candidates.label: cand-0704: Topic from 17:75
candidates.definition: In 17:75: Then [if you had], We would have made you taste double [punishment in] life and double [after] death. Then you would not find for yourself against Us a helper

candidates.label: cand-0705: Topic from 17:78
candidates.definition: In 17:78: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur'an of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed

candidates.label: cand-0706: Topic from 17:81
candidates.definition: In 17:81: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart

candidates.label: cand-0707: Topic from 17:85
candidates.definition: In 17:85: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair of my Lord. And mankind have not been given of knowledge except a little

candidates.label: cand-0708: Topic from 17:87
candidates.definition: In 17:87: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great

candidates.label: cand-0709: Topic from 17:90
candidates.definition: In 17:90: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring

candidates.label: cand-0710: Topic from 17:92
candidates.definition: In 17:92: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allah and the angels before [us]

candidates.label: cand-0711: Topic from 17:95
candidates.definition: In 17:95: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger

candidates.label: cand-0712: Topic from 17:98
candidates.definition: In 17:98: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation

candidates.label: cand-0713: Topic from 17:100
candidates.definition: In 17:100: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy

candidates.label: cand-0714: Topic from 17:103
candidates.definition: In 17:103: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together

candidates.label: cand-0715: Topic from 17:105
candidates.definition: In 17:105: And with the truth We have sent the Qur'an down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner

candidates.label: cand-0716: Topic from 17:108
candidates.definition: In 17:108: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled

candidates.label: cand-0717: Topic from 18:1
candidates.definition: In 18:1: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance

candidates.label: cand-0718: Topic from 18:3
candidates.definition: In 18:3: In which they will remain forever

candidates.label: cand-0719: Topic from 18:6
candidates.definition: In 18:6: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow

candidates.label: cand-0720: Topic from 18:9
candidates.definition: In 18:9: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder

candidates.label: cand-0721: Topic from 18:11
candidates.definition: In 18:11: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years

candidates.label: cand-0722: Topic from 18:14
candidates.definition: In 18:14: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression

candidates.label: cand-0723: Topic from 18:17
candidates.definition: In 18:17: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allah. He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide

candidates.label: cand-0724: Topic from 18:19
candidates.definition: In 18:19: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you

candidates.label: cand-0725: Topic from 18:22
candidates.definition: In 18:22: They will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone

candidates.label: cand-0726: Topic from 18:25
candidates.definition: In 18:25: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine

candidates.label: cand-0727: Topic from 18:29
candidates.definition: In 18:29: And say, "The truth is from your Lord, so whoever wills - let him believe; and whoever wills - let him disbelieve." Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place

candidates.label: cand-0728: Topic from 18:31
candidates.definition: In 18:31: Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place

candidates.label: cand-0729: Topic from 18:34
candidates.definition: In 18:34: And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, "I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men

candidates.label: cand-0730: Topic from 18:37
candidates.definition: In 18:37: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man

candidates.label: cand-0731: Topic from 18:39
candidates.definition: In 18:39: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allah willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allah '? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children

candidates.label: cand-0732: Topic from 18:42
candidates.definition: In 18:42: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone

candidates.label: cand-0733: Topic from 18:45
candidates.definition: In 18:45: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability

candidates.label: cand-0734: Topic from 18:47
candidates.definition: In 18:47: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth prominent, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone

candidates.label: cand-0735: Topic from 18:50
candidates.definition: In 18:50: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange

candidates.label: cand-0736: Topic from 18:53
candidates.definition: In 18:53: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere

candidates.label: cand-0737: Topic from 18:57
candidates.definition: In 18:57: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever

candidates.label: cand-0738: Topic from 18:59
candidates.definition: In 18:59: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time

candidates.label: cand-0739: Topic from 18:62
candidates.definition: In 18:62: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue

candidates.label: cand-0740: Topic from 18:65
candidates.definition: In 18:65: And they found a servant from among Our servants to whom we had given mercy from us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge

candidates.label: cand-0741: Topic from 18:67
candidates.definition: In 18:67: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience

candidates.label: cand-0742: Topic from 18:70
candidates.definition: In 18:70: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention

candidates.label: cand-0743: Topic from 18:73
candidates.definition: In 18:73: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not cover me in my matter with difficulty

candidates.label: cand-0744: Topic from 18:75
candidates.definition: In 18:75: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience

candidates.label: cand-0745: Topic from 18:78
candidates.definition: In 18:78: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience

candidates.label: cand-0746: Topic from 18:81
candidates.definition: In 18:81: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy

candidates.label: cand-0747: Topic from 18:85
candidates.definition: In 18:85: So he followed a way

candidates.label: cand-0748: Topic from 18:87
candidates.definition: In 18:87: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment

candidates.label: cand-0749: Topic from 18:90
candidates.definition: In 18:90: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield

candidates.label: cand-0750: Topic from 18:92
candidates.definition: In 18:92: Then he followed a way

candidates.label: cand-0751: Topic from 18:95
candidates.definition: In 18:95: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam

candidates.label: cand-0752: Topic from 18:97
candidates.definition: In 18:97: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration

candidates.label: cand-0753: Topic from 18:100
candidates.definition: In 18:100: And We will present Hell that Day to the Disbelievers, on display

candidates.label: cand-0754: Topic from 18:102
candidates.definition: In 18:102: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging

candidates.label: cand-0755: Topic from 18:105
candidates.definition: In 18:105: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance

candidates.label: cand-0756: Topic from 18:107
candidates.definition: In 18:107: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging

candidates.label: cand-0757: Topic from 19:1
candidates.definition: In 19:1: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad

candidates.label: cand-0758: Topic from 19:4
candidates.definition: In 19:4: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy

candidates.label: cand-0759: Topic from 19:7
candidates.definition: In 19:7: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name

candidates.label: cand-0760: Topic from 19:10
candidates.definition: In 19:10: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound

candidates.label: cand-0761: Topic from 19:13
candidates.definition: In 19:13: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah

candidates.label: cand-0762: Topic from 19:17
candidates.definition: In 19:17: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man

candidates.label: cand-0763: Topic from 19:20
candidates.definition: In 19:20: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste

candidates.label: cand-0764: Topic from 19:23
candidates.definition: In 19:23: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten

candidates.label: cand-0765: Topic from 19:26
candidates.definition: In 19:26: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man

candidates.definition: In 27:7: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves

candidates.label: cand-1060: Topic from 27:10
candidates.definition: In 27:10: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear

candidates.label: cand-1061: Topic from 27:13
candidates.definition: In 27:13: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic

candidates.label: cand-1062: Topic from 27:16
candidates.definition: In 27:16: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty

candidates.label: cand-1063: Topic from 27:19
candidates.definition: In 27:19: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants

candidates.label: cand-1064: Topic from 27:22
candidates.definition: In 27:22: But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news

candidates.label: cand-1065: Topic from 27:25
candidates.definition: In 27:25: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allah, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare

candidates.label: cand-1066: Topic from 27:28
candidates.definition: In 27:28: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return

candidates.label: cand-1067: Topic from 27:32
candidates.definition: In 27:32: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me

candidates.label: cand-1068: Topic from 27:35
candidates.definition: In 27:35: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return

candidates.label: cand-1069: Topic from 27:38
candidates.definition: In 27:38: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission

candidates.label: cand-1070: Topic from 27:41
candidates.definition: In 27:41: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided

candidates.label: cand-1071: Topic from 27:44
candidates.definition: In 27:44: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds

candidates.label: cand-1072: Topic from 27:47
candidates.definition: In 27:47: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen is with Allah. Rather, you are a people being tested

candidates.label: cand-1073: Topic from 27:50
candidates.definition: In 27:50: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not

candidates.label: cand-1074: Topic from 27:53
candidates.definition: In 27:53: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah

candidates.label: cand-1075: Topic from 27:56
candidates.definition: In 27:56: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure

candidates.label: cand-1076: Topic from 27:59
candidates.definition: In 27:59: Say, [O Muhammad], "Praise be to Allah, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allah better or what they associate with Him

candidates.label: cand-1077: Topic from 27:63
candidates.definition: In 27:63: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allah? High is Allah above whatever they associate with Him

candidates.label: cand-1078: Topic from 27:66
candidates.definition: In 27:66: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind

candidates.label: cand-1079: Topic from 27:69
candidates.definition: In 27:69: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals

candidates.label: cand-1080: Topic from 27:72
candidates.definition: In 27:72: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you - some of that for which you are impatient

candidates.label: cand-1081: Topic from 27:75
candidates.definition: In 27:75: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register

candidates.label: cand-1082: Topic from 27:78
candidates.definition: In 27:78: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

candidates.label: cand-1083: Topic from 27:81
candidates.definition: In 27:81: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [submitting to Allah]

candidates.label: cand-1084: Topic from 27:84
candidates.definition: In 27:84: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing

candidates.label: cand-1085: Topic from 27:87
candidates.definition: In 27:87: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allah wills. And all will come to Him humbled

candidates.label: cand-1086: Topic from 27:90
candidates.definition: In 27:90: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do

candidates.label: cand-1087: Topic from 28:1
candidates.definition: In 28:1: Ta, Seen, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1088: Topic from 28:3
candidates.definition: In 28:3: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe

candidates.label: cand-1089: Topic from 28:6
candidates.definition: In 28:6: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared

candidates.label: cand-1090: Topic from 28:9
candidates.definition: In 28:9: And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son." And they perceived not

candidates.label: cand-1091: Topic from 28:12
candidates.definition: In 28:12: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere

candidates.label: cand-1092: Topic from 28:15
candidates.definition: In 28:15: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy. And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him. [Moses] said, "This is from the work of Satan. Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy

candidates.label: cand-1093: Topic from 28:18
candidates.definition: In 28:18: And he became inside the city fearful and anticipating [exposure], when suddenly the one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him [once again]. Moses said to him, "Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator

candidates.label: cand-1094: Topic from 28:21
candidates.definition: In 28:21: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people

candidates.label: cand-1095: Topic from 28:24
candidates.definition: In 28:24: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need

candidates.label: cand-1096: Topic from 28:27
candidates.definition: In 28:27: He said, "Indeed, I wish to wed you one of these, my two daughters, on [the condition] that you serve me for eight years; but if you complete ten, it will be [as a favor] from you. And I do not wish to put you in difficulty. You will find me, if Allah wills, from among the righteous

candidates.label: cand-1097: Topic from 28:31
candidates.definition: In 28:31: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it was a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, approach and fear not. Indeed, you are of the secure

candidates.label: cand-1098: Topic from 28:33
candidates.definition: In 28:33: He said, "My Lord, indeed, I killed from among them someone, and I fear they will kill me

candidates.label: cand-1099: Topic from 28:36
candidates.definition: In 28:36: But when Moses came to them with Our signs as clear evidences, they said, "This is not except invented magic, and we have not heard of this [religion] among our forefathers

candidates.label: cand-1100: Topic from 28:39
candidates.definition: In 28:39: And he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us

candidates.label: cand-1101: Topic from 28:42
candidates.definition: In 28:42: And We caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised

candidates.label: cand-1102: Topic from 28:45
candidates.definition: In 28:45: But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration. And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message]

candidates.label: cand-1103: Topic from 28:48
candidates.definition: In 28:48: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, "[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers

candidates.label: cand-1104: Topic from 28:51
candidates.definition: In 28:51: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the Qur'an that they might be reminded

candidates.label: cand-1105: Topic from 28:54
candidates.definition: In 28:54: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend

candidates.label: cand-1106: Topic from 28:57
candidates.definition: In 28:57: And they say, "If we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land." Have we not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us? But most of them do not know

candidates.label: cand-1107: Topic from 28:61
candidates.definition: In 28:61: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will obtain like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]

candidates.label: cand-1108: Topic from 28:63
candidates.definition: In 28:63: Those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we led to error. We led them to error just as we were in error. We declare our disassociation [from them] to You. They did not used to worship us

candidates.label: cand-1109: Topic from 28:66
candidates.definition: In 28:66: But the information will be unapparent to them that Day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another

candidates.label: cand-1110: Topic from 28:69
candidates.definition: In 28:69: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare

candidates.label: cand-1111: Topic from 28:71
candidates.definition: In 28:71: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allah could bring you light? Then will you not hear

candidates.label: cand-1112: Topic from 28:74
candidates.definition: In 28:74: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are my 'partners' which you used to claim

candidates.label: cand-1113: Topic from 28:77
candidates.definition: In 28:77: But seek, through that which Allah has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. And do good as Allah has done good to you. And desire not corruption in the land. Indeed, Allah does not like corrupters

candidates.label: cand-1114: Topic from 28:79
candidates.definition: In 28:79: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qarun. Indeed, he is one of great fortune

candidates.label: cand-1115: Topic from 28:82
candidates.definition: In 28:82: And those who had wished for his position the previous day began to say, "Oh, how Allah extends provision to whom He wills of His servants and restricts it! If not that Allah had conferred favor on us, He would have caused it to swallow us. Oh, how the disbelievers do not succeed

candidates.label: cand-1116: Topic from 28:85
candidates.definition: In 28:85: Indeed, [O Muhammad], He who imposed upon you the Qur'an will take you back to a place of return. Say, "My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error

candidates.label: cand-1117: Topic from 29:1
candidates.definition: In 29:1: Alif, Lam, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1118: Topic from 29:4
candidates.definition: In 29:4: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us? Evil is what they judge

candidates.label: cand-1119: Topic from 29:7
candidates.definition: In 29:7: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do

candidates.label: cand-1120: Topic from 29:11
candidates.definition: In 29:11: And Allah will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites

candidates.label: cand-1121: Topic from 29:14
candidates.definition: In 29:14: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers

candidates.label: cand-1122: Topic from 29:18
candidates.definition: In 29:18: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification

candidates.label: cand-1123: Topic from 29:21
candidates.definition: In 29:21: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned

candidates.label: cand-1124: Topic from 29:24
candidates.definition: In 29:24: And the answer of Abraham's people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allah saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

candidates.label: cand-1125: Topic from 29:28
candidates.definition: In 29:28: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds

candidates.label: cand-1126: Topic from 29:31
candidates.definition: In 29:31: And when Our messengers came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that Lot's city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers

candidates.label: cand-1127: Topic from 29:36
candidates.definition: In 29:36: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

candidates.label: cand-1128: Topic from 29:39
candidates.definition: In 29:39: And [We destroyed] Qarun and Pharaoh and Haman. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]

candidates.label: cand-1129: Topic from 29:42
candidates.definition: In 29:42: Indeed, Allah knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1130: Topic from 29:45
candidates.definition: In 29:45: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do

candidates.label: cand-1131: Topic from 29:49
candidates.definition: In 29:49: Rather, the Qur'an is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers

candidates.label: cand-1132: Topic from 29:52
candidates.definition: In 29:52: Say, "Sufficient is Allah between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allah - it is those who are the losers

candidates.label: cand-1133: Topic from 29:55
candidates.definition: In 29:55: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do

candidates.label: cand-1134: Topic from 29:59
candidates.definition: In 29:59: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely

candidates.label: cand-1135: Topic from 29:62
candidates.definition: In 29:62: Allah extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing

candidates.label: cand-1136: Topic from 29:65
candidates.definition: In 29:65: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him

candidates.label: cand-1137: Topic from 30:1
candidates.definition: In 30:1: Alif, Lam, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1138: Topic from 30:3
candidates.definition: In 30:3: In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome

candidates.label: cand-1139: Topic from 30:6
candidates.definition: In 30:6: [It is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know

candidates.label: cand-1140: Topic from 30:9
candidates.definition: In 30:9: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed the earth and built it up more than they have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allah would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves

candidates.label: cand-1141: Topic from 30:12
candidates.definition: In 30:12: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair

candidates.label: cand-1142: Topic from 30:15
candidates.definition: In 30:15: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted

candidates.label: cand-1143: Topic from 30:18
candidates.definition: In 30:18: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon

candidates.label: cand-1144: Topic from 30:21
candidates.definition: In 30:21: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

candidates.label: cand-1145: Topic from 30:24
candidates.definition: In 30:24: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason

candidates.label: cand-1146: Topic from 30:27
candidates.definition: In 30:27: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest attribute in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1147: Topic from 30:31
candidates.definition: In 30:31: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allah

candidates.label: cand-1148: Topic from 30:33
candidates.definition: In 30:33: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord

candidates.label: cand-1149: Topic from 30:36
candidates.definition: In 30:36: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair

candidates.label: cand-1150: Topic from 30:39
candidates.definition: In 30:39: And whatever you give for interest to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allah. But what you give in zakah, desiring the countenance of Allah - those are the multipliers

candidates.label: cand-1151: Topic from 30:42
candidates.definition: In 30:42: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allah]

candidates.label: cand-1152: Topic from 30:45
candidates.definition: In 30:45: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers

candidates.label: cand-1153: Topic from 30:48
candidates.definition: In 30:48: It is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice

candidates.label: cand-1154: Topic from 30:51
candidates.definition: In 30:51: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers

candidates.label: cand-1155: Topic from 30:54
candidates.definition: In 30:54: Allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent

candidates.label: cand-1156: Topic from 30:57
candidates.definition: In 30:57: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah]

candidates.label: cand-1157: Topic from 31:1
candidates.definition: In 31:1: Alif, Lam, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1158: Topic from 31:2
candidates.definition: In 31:2: These are verses of the wise Book

candidates.label: cand-1159: Topic from 31:4
candidates.definition: In 31:4: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith]

candidates.label: cand-1160: Topic from 31:5
candidates.definition: In 31:5: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

candidates.label: cand-1161: Topic from 31:7
candidates.definition: In 31:7: And when our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-1162: Topic from 31:9
candidates.definition: In 31:9: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allah [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1163: Topic from 31:10
candidates.definition: In 31:10: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind

candidates.label: cand-1164: Topic from 31:12
candidates.definition: In 31:12: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy

candidates.label: cand-1165: Topic from 31:13
candidates.definition: In 31:13: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with him] is great injustice

candidates.label: cand-1166: Topic from 31:15
candidates.definition: In 31:15: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do

candidates.label: cand-1167: Topic from 31:18
candidates.definition: In 31:18: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful

candidates.label: cand-1168: Topic from 31:19
candidates.definition: In 31:19: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys

candidates.label: cand-1169: Topic from 31:21
candidates.definition: In 31:21: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze

candidates.label: cand-1170: Topic from 31:22
candidates.definition: In 31:22: And whoever submits his face to Allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah will be the outcome of [all] matters

candidates.label: cand-1171: Topic from 31:24
candidates.definition: In 31:24: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment

candidates.label: cand-1172: Topic from 31:26
candidates.definition: In 31:26: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy

candidates.label: cand-1173: Topic from 31:27
candidates.definition: In 31:27: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allah would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

candidates.label: cand-1174: Topic from 31:29
candidates.definition: In 31:29: Do you not see that Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allah, with whatever you do, is Acquainted

candidates.label: cand-1175: Topic from 31:30
candidates.definition: In 31:30: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that what they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand

candidates.label: cand-1176: Topic from 31:32
candidates.definition: In 31:32: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful

candidates.label: cand-1177: Topic from 32:1
candidates.definition: In 32:1: Alif, Lam, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1178: Topic from 32:2
candidates.definition: In 32:2: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds

candidates.label: cand-1179: Topic from 32:3
candidates.definition: In 32:3: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided

candidates.label: cand-1180: Topic from 32:5
candidates.definition: In 32:5: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count

candidates.label: cand-1181: Topic from 32:6
candidates.definition: In 32:6: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

candidates.label: cand-1182: Topic from 32:8
candidates.definition: In 32:8: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained

candidates.label: cand-1183: Topic from 32:9
candidates.definition: In 32:9: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

candidates.label: cand-1184: Topic from 32:10

candidates.label: cand-1185: Topic from 32:12
candidates.definition: In 32:12: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain

candidates.label: cand-1186: Topic from 32:13
candidates.definition: In 32:13: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together

candidates.label: cand-1187: Topic from 32:16
candidates.definition: In 32:16: They arise from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend

candidates.label: cand-1188: Topic from 32:17
candidates.definition: In 32:17: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes as reward for what they used to do

candidates.label: cand-1189: Topic from 32:18
candidates.definition: In 32:18: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal

candidates.label: cand-1190: Topic from 32:20
candidates.definition: In 32:20: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny

candidates.label: cand-1191: Topic from 32:21
candidates.definition: In 32:21: And we will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will repent

candidates.label: cand-1192: Topic from 32:23
candidates.definition: In 32:23: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel

candidates.label: cand-1193: Topic from 32:24
candidates.definition: In 32:24: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs

candidates.label: cand-1194: Topic from 32:25
candidates.definition: In 32:25: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

candidates.label: cand-1195: Topic from 32:27
candidates.definition: In 32:27: Have they not seen that We drive the water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see

candidates.label: cand-1196: Topic from 32:28
candidates.definition: In 32:28: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful

candidates.label: cand-1197: Topic from 33:1
candidates.definition: In 33:1: O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise

candidates.label: cand-1198: Topic from 33:3
candidates.definition: In 33:3: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs

candidates.label: cand-1199: Topic from 33:5
candidates.definition: In 33:5: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful

candidates.label: cand-1200: Topic from 33:8
candidates.definition: In 33:8: That He may question the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-1201: Topic from 33:10
candidates.definition: In 33:10: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats and you assumed about Allah [various] assumptions

candidates.label: cand-1202: Topic from 33:13
candidates.definition: In 33:13: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are unprotected," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee

candidates.label: cand-1203: Topic from 33:15
candidates.definition: In 33:15: And they had already promised Allah before not to turn their backs and flee. And ever is the promise to Allah [that about which one will be] questioned

candidates.label: cand-1204: Topic from 33:17
candidates.definition: In 33:17: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allah if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allah any protector or any helper

candidates.label: cand-1205: Topic from 33:20
candidates.definition: In 33:20: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little

candidates.label: cand-1206: Topic from 33:22
candidates.definition: In 33:22: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us, and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance

candidates.label: cand-1207: Topic from 33:26
candidates.definition: In 33:26: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party you killed, and you took captive a party

candidates.label: cand-1208: Topic from 33:28
candidates.definition: In 33:28: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release

candidates.label: cand-1209: Topic from 33:30
candidates.definition: In 33:30: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allah, easy

candidates.label: cand-1210: Topic from 33:33
candidates.definition: In 33:33: And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification

candidates.label: cand-1211: Topic from 33:35
candidates.definition: In 33:35: Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allah often and the women who do so - for them Allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward

candidates.label: cand-1212: Topic from 33:38
candidates.definition: In 33:38: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allah has imposed upon him. [This is] the established way of Allah with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allah a destiny decreed

candidates.label: cand-1213: Topic from 33:40
candidates.definition: In 33:40: Muhammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allah and last of the prophets. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing

candidates.label: cand-1214: Topic from 33:42
candidates.definition: In 33:42: And exalt Him morning and afternoon

candidates.label: cand-1215: Topic from 33:45
candidates.definition: In 33:45: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

candidates.label: cand-1216: Topic from 33:47
candidates.definition: In 33:47: And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allah great bounty

candidates.label: cand-1217: Topic from 33:51
candidates.definition: In 33:51: You, [O Muhammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. And ever is Allah Knowing and Forbearing

candidates.label: cand-1218: Topic from 33:53
candidates.definition: In 33:53: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. But Allah is not shy of the truth. And when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allah or to marry his wives after him, ever. Indeed, that would be in the sight of Allah an enormity

candidates.label: cand-1219: Topic from 33:55
candidates.definition: In 33:55: There is no blame upon women concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess. And fear Allah. Indeed Allah is ever, over all things, Witness

candidates.label: cand-1220: Topic from 33:57
candidates.definition: In 33:57: Indeed, those who abuse Allah and His Messenger - Allah has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment

candidates.label: cand-1221: Topic from 33:59
candidates.definition: In 33:59: O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments. That is more suitable that they will be known and not be abused. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful

candidates.label: cand-1222: Topic from 33:62
candidates.definition: In 33:62: [This is] the established way of Allah with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allah any change

candidates.label: cand-1223: Topic from 33:64
candidates.definition: In 33:64: Indeed, Allah has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze

candidates.label: cand-1224: Topic from 33:66
candidates.definition: In 33:66: The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger

candidates.label: cand-1225: Topic from 33:68
candidates.definition: In 33:68: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse

candidates.label: cand-1226: Topic from 33:70
candidates.definition: In 33:70: O you who have believed, fear Allah and speak words of appropriate justice

candidates.label: cand-1228: Topic from 34:3
candidates.definition: In 34:3: But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. [Allah is] the Knower of the unseen." candidates.label: cand-1229: Topic from 34:6
candidates.definition: In 34:6: And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy

candidates.label: cand-1231: Topic from 34:11
candidates.definition: In 34:11: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing

candidates.label: cand-1235: Topic from 34:21

candidates.definition: In 34:24: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allah. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error

candidates.label: cand-1239: Topic from 34:33

candidates.label: cand-1240: Topic from 34:35

candidates.label: cand-1243: Topic from 34:43

candidates.label: cand-1245: Topic from 34:48
candidates.definition: In 34:48: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth. Knower of the unseen

candidates.label: cand-1246: Topic from 34:51
candidates.definition: In 34:51: And if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby

candidates.label: cand-1247: Topic from 35:1

candidates.definition: In 35:20: Nor are the darknesses and the light

candidates.label: cand-1261: Topic from 35:32

candidates.label: cand-1262: Topic from 35:34

candidates.label: cand-1266: Topic from 35:42

candidates.label: cand-1267: Topic from 36:1
candidates.definition: In 36:1: Ya, Seen

candidates.definition: In 36:3: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers

candidates.definition: In 36:11: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward

candidates.definition: In 36:25: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me

candidates.definition: In 36:42: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride

candidates.definition: In 36:45: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy

candidates.definition: In 36:47: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error

candidates.definition: In 36:50: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return

candidates.label: cand-1296: Topic from 36:80

candidates.definition: In 37:4: Indeed, your God is One

candidates.definition: In 37:15: And say, "This is not but obvious magic

candidates.label: cand-1307: Topic from 37:38

candidates.label: cand-1331: Topic from 37:126

candidates.label: cand-1338: Topic from 37:152

candidates.label: cand-1339: Topic from 37:155
candidates.definition: In 37:155: Then will you not be reminded

candidates.label: cand-1340: Topic from 37:158

candidates.definition: In 37:162: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

candidates.definition: In 37:165: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer]
