candidates.definition: In 37:168: If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples

candidates.label: cand-1344: Topic from 37:172
candidates.definition: In 37:172: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

candidates.label: cand-1345: Topic from 37:175
candidates.definition: In 37:175: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see

candidates.label: cand-1346: Topic from 37:178
candidates.definition: In 37:178: And leave them for a time

candidates.label: cand-1347: Topic from 38:1
candidates.definition: In 38:1: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder

candidates.label: cand-1348: Topic from 38:3
candidates.definition: In 38:3: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape

candidates.label: cand-1349: Topic from 38:6
candidates.definition: In 38:6: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended

candidates.label: cand-1350: Topic from 38:9
candidates.definition: In 38:9: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower

candidates.label: cand-1351: Topic from 38:12
candidates.definition: In 38:12: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes

candidates.label: cand-1352: Topic from 38:15
candidates.definition: In 38:15: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay

candidates.label: cand-1353: Topic from 38:18
candidates.definition: In 38:18: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise

candidates.label: cand-1354: Topic from 38:21
candidates.definition: In 38:21: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber

candidates.label: cand-1355: Topic from 38:24
candidates.definition: In 38:24: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah]

candidates.label: cand-1356: Topic from 38:27
candidates.definition: In 38:27: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire

candidates.label: cand-1357: Topic from 38:31
candidates.definition: In 38:31: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses

candidates.label: cand-1358: Topic from 38:33
candidates.definition: In 38:33: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks

candidates.label: cand-1359: Topic from 38:36
candidates.definition: In 38:36: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed

candidates.label: cand-1360: Topic from 38:39
candidates.definition: In 38:39: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account

candidates.label: cand-1361: Topic from 38:42
candidates.definition: In 38:42: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink

candidates.label: cand-1362: Topic from 38:45
candidates.definition: In 38:45: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision

candidates.label: cand-1363: Topic from 38:48
candidates.definition: In 38:48: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding

candidates.label: cand-1364: Topic from 38:51
candidates.definition: In 38:51: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink

candidates.label: cand-1365: Topic from 38:54
candidates.definition: In 38:54: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion

candidates.label: cand-1366: Topic from 38:57
candidates.definition: In 38:57: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence

candidates.label: cand-1367: Topic from 38:61
candidates.definition: In 38:61: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire

candidates.label: cand-1368: Topic from 38:63
candidates.definition: In 38:63: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them

candidates.label: cand-1369: Topic from 38:66
candidates.definition: In 38:66: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver

candidates.label: cand-1370: Topic from 38:69
candidates.definition: In 38:69: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam]

candidates.label: cand-1371: Topic from 38:71
candidates.definition: In 38:71: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay

candidates.label: cand-1372: Topic from 38:74
candidates.definition: In 38:74: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers

candidates.label: cand-1373: Topic from 38:77
candidates.definition: In 38:77: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled

candidates.label: cand-1374: Topic from 38:79
candidates.definition: In 38:79: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected

candidates.label: cand-1375: Topic from 38:82
candidates.definition: In 38:82: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all

candidates.label: cand-1376: Topic from 38:85
candidates.definition: In 38:85: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together

candidates.label: cand-1377: Topic from 39:1
candidates.definition: In 39:1: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1378: Topic from 39:3
candidates.definition: In 39:3: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever

candidates.label: cand-1379: Topic from 39:5
candidates.definition: In 39:5: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver

candidates.label: cand-1380: Topic from 39:8
candidates.definition: In 39:8: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire

candidates.label: cand-1381: Topic from 39:10
candidates.definition: In 39:10: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account

candidates.label: cand-1382: Topic from 39:13
candidates.definition: In 39:13: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day

candidates.label: cand-1383: Topic from 39:15
candidates.definition: In 39:15: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss

candidates.label: cand-1384: Topic from 39:17
candidates.definition: In 39:17: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants

candidates.label: cand-1385: Topic from 39:20
candidates.definition: In 39:20: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise

candidates.label: cand-1386: Topic from 39:22
candidates.definition: In 39:22: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error

candidates.label: cand-1387: Topic from 39:26
candidates.definition: In 39:26: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew

candidates.label: cand-1388: Topic from 39:28
candidates.definition: In 39:28: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous

candidates.label: cand-1389: Topic from 39:30
candidates.definition: In 39:30: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die

candidates.label: cand-1390: Topic from 39:33
candidates.definition: In 39:33: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous

candidates.label: cand-1391: Topic from 39:35
candidates.definition: In 39:35: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do

candidates.label: cand-1392: Topic from 39:38
candidates.definition: In 39:38: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers

candidates.label: cand-1393: Topic from 39:40
candidates.definition: In 39:40: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment

candidates.label: cand-1394: Topic from 39:42
candidates.definition: In 39:42: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

candidates.label: cand-1395: Topic from 39:45
candidates.definition: In 39:45: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice

candidates.label: cand-1396: Topic from 39:47
candidates.definition: In 39:47: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allah that which they had not taken into account

candidates.label: cand-1397: Topic from 39:51
candidates.definition: In 39:51: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be afflicted by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure

candidates.label: cand-1398: Topic from 39:53
candidates.definition: In 39:53: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful

candidates.label: cand-1399: Topic from 39:55
candidates.definition: In 39:55: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive

candidates.label: cand-1400: Topic from 39:58
candidates.definition: In 39:58: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good

candidates.label: cand-1401: Topic from 39:60
candidates.definition: In 39:60: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant

candidates.label: cand-1402: Topic from 39:63
candidates.definition: In 39:63: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allah - it is those who are the losers

candidates.label: cand-1403: Topic from 39:65
candidates.definition: In 39:65: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers

candidates.label: cand-1404: Topic from 39:67
candidates.definition: In 39:67: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him

candidates.label: cand-1405: Topic from 39:70
candidates.definition: In 39:70: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do

candidates.label: cand-1406: Topic from 39:72
candidates.definition: In 39:72: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant

candidates.label: cand-1407: Topic from 40:1
candidates.definition: In 40:1: Ha, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1408: Topic from 40:3
candidates.definition: In 40:3: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination

candidates.label: cand-1409: Topic from 40:6
candidates.definition: In 40:6: And thus has the word of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire

candidates.label: cand-1410: Topic from 40:9
candidates.definition: In 40:9: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment

candidates.label: cand-1411: Topic from 40:12
candidates.definition: In 40:12: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allah, the Most High, the Grand

candidates.label: cand-1412: Topic from 40:15
candidates.definition: In 40:15: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting

candidates.label: cand-1413: Topic from 40:17
candidates.definition: In 40:17: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allah is swift in account

candidates.label: cand-1414: Topic from 40:20
candidates.definition: In 40:20: And Allah judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allah - He is the Hearing, the Seeing

candidates.label: cand-1415: Topic from 40:23
candidates.definition: In 40:23: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

candidates.label: cand-1416: Topic from 40:26
candidates.definition: In 40:26: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land

candidates.label: cand-1417: Topic from 40:30
candidates.definition: In 40:30: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies

candidates.label: cand-1418: Topic from 40:32
candidates.definition: In 40:32: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling

candidates.label: cand-1419: Topic from 40:35
candidates.definition: In 40:35: Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allah seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant

candidates.label: cand-1420: Topic from 40:38
candidates.definition: In 40:38: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me, I will guide you to the way of right conduct

candidates.label: cand-1421: Topic from 40:41
candidates.definition: In 40:41: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire

candidates.label: cand-1422: Topic from 40:44
candidates.definition: In 40:44: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants

candidates.label: cand-1423: Topic from 40:46
candidates.definition: In 40:46: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment

candidates.label: cand-1424: Topic from 40:49
candidates.definition: In 40:49: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment

candidates.label: cand-1425: Topic from 40:52
candidates.definition: In 40:52: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home

candidates.label: cand-1426: Topic from 40:55
candidates.definition: In 40:55: So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning

candidates.label: cand-1427: Topic from 40:59
candidates.definition: In 40:59: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe

candidates.label: cand-1428: Topic from 40:61
candidates.definition: In 40:61: It is Allah who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people are not grateful

candidates.label: cand-1429: Topic from 40:64
candidates.definition: In 40:64: It is Allah who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a ceiling and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allah, your Lord; then blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds

candidates.label: cand-1430: Topic from 40:66
candidates.definition: In 40:66: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allah once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds

candidates.label: cand-1431: Topic from 40:69
candidates.definition: In 40:69: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah - how are they averted

candidates.label: cand-1432: Topic from 40:72
candidates.definition: In 40:72: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame]

candidates.label: cand-1433: Topic from 40:74
candidates.definition: In 40:74: Other than Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allah put astray the disbelievers

candidates.label: cand-1434: Topic from 40:77
candidates.definition: In 40:77: So be patient, [O Muhammad]; indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned

candidates.label: cand-1435: Topic from 40:79
candidates.definition: In 40:79: It is Allah who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat

candidates.label: cand-1436: Topic from 40:82
candidates.definition: In 40:82: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn

candidates.label: cand-1437: Topic from 41:1
candidates.definition: In 41:1: Ha, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1438: Topic from 41:3
candidates.definition: In 41:3: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur'an for a people who know

candidates.label: cand-1439: Topic from 41:6
candidates.definition: In 41:6: Say, O [Muhammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allah

candidates.label: cand-1440: Topic from 41:8
candidates.definition: In 41:8: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted

candidates.label: cand-1441: Topic from 41:11
candidates.definition: In 41:11: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly

candidates.label: cand-1442: Topic from 41:14
candidates.definition: In 41:14: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allah." They said, "If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers

candidates.label: cand-1443: Topic from 41:16
candidates.definition: In 41:16: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped

candidates.label: cand-1444: Topic from 41:19
candidates.definition: In 41:19: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven] assembled in rows

candidates.label: cand-1445: Topic from 41:21
candidates.definition: In 41:21: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allah, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned

candidates.label: cand-1446: Topic from 41:24
candidates.definition: In 41:24: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allah], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease

candidates.label: cand-1447: Topic from 41:28
candidates.definition: In 41:28: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting

candidates.label: cand-1448: Topic from 41:30
candidates.definition: In 41:30: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah " and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised

candidates.label: cand-1449: Topic from 41:33
candidates.definition: In 41:33: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims

candidates.label: cand-1450: Topic from 41:35
candidates.definition: In 41:35: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good]

candidates.label: cand-1451: Topic from 41:38
candidates.definition: In 41:38: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary

candidates.label: cand-1452: Topic from 41:41
candidates.definition: In 41:41: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book

candidates.label: cand-1453: Topic from 41:43
candidates.definition: In 41:43: Nothing is said to you, [O Muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty

candidates.label: cand-1454: Topic from 41:46
candidates.definition: In 41:46: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants

candidates.label: cand-1455: Topic from 41:48
candidates.definition: In 41:48: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape

candidates.label: cand-1456: Topic from 41:51
candidates.definition: In 41:51: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication

candidates.label: cand-1457: Topic from 42:1
candidates.definition: In 42:1: Ha, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1458: Topic from 42:3
candidates.definition: In 42:3: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and to those before you - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1459: Topic from 42:6
candidates.definition: In 42:6: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allah is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muhammad], are not over them a manager

candidates.label: cand-1460: Topic from 42:8
candidates.definition: In 42:8: And if Allah willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper

candidates.label: cand-1461: Topic from 42:11
candidates.definition: In 42:11: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing

candidates.label: cand-1462: Topic from 42:14
candidates.definition: In 42:14: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt

candidates.label: cand-1463: Topic from 42:16
candidates.definition: In 42:16: And those who argue concerning Allah after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment

candidates.label: cand-1464: Topic from 42:19
candidates.definition: In 42:19: Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might

candidates.label: cand-1465: Topic from 42:21
candidates.definition: In 42:21: Or have they other deities who have ordained for them a religion to which Allah has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-1466: Topic from 42:24
candidates.definition: In 42:24: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allah a lie"? But if Allah willed, He could seal over your heart. And Allah eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts

candidates.label: cand-1467: Topic from 42:28
candidates.definition: In 42:28: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy

candidates.label: cand-1468: Topic from 42:30
candidates.definition: In 42:30: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much

candidates.label: cand-1469: Topic from 42:33
candidates.definition: In 42:33: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful

candidates.label: cand-1470: Topic from 42:35
candidates.definition: In 42:35: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape

candidates.label: cand-1471: Topic from 42:38
candidates.definition: In 42:38: And those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend

candidates.label: cand-1472: Topic from 42:40
candidates.definition: In 42:40: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allah. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers

candidates.label: cand-1473: Topic from 42:43
candidates.definition: In 42:43: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination

candidates.label: cand-1474: Topic from 42:45
candidates.definition: In 42:45: And you will see them being exposed to the Fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment

candidates.label: cand-1475: Topic from 42:48
candidates.definition: In 42:48: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful

candidates.label: cand-1476: Topic from 42:50
candidates.definition: In 42:50: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent

candidates.label: cand-1477: Topic from 43:1
candidates.definition: In 43:1: Ha, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1478: Topic from 43:3
candidates.definition: In 43:3: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand

candidates.label: cand-1479: Topic from 43:6
candidates.definition: In 43:6: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples

candidates.label: cand-1480: Topic from 43:9
candidates.definition: In 43:9: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

candidates.label: cand-1481: Topic from 43:12
candidates.definition: In 43:12: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount

candidates.label: cand-1482: Topic from 43:15
candidates.definition: In 43:15: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful

candidates.label: cand-1483: Topic from 43:18
candidates.definition: In 43:18: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]

candidates.label: cand-1484: Topic from 43:21
candidates.definition: In 43:21: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering

candidates.label: cand-1485: Topic from 43:24
candidates.definition: In 43:24: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers

candidates.label: cand-1486: Topic from 43:27
candidates.definition: In 43:27: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me

candidates.label: cand-1487: Topic from 43:31
candidates.definition: In 43:31: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities

candidates.label: cand-1488: Topic from 43:33
candidates.definition: In 43:33: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount

candidates.label: cand-1489: Topic from 43:36
candidates.definition: In 43:36: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion

candidates.label: cand-1490: Topic from 43:39
candidates.definition: In 43:39: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment

candidates.label: cand-1491: Topic from 43:42
candidates.definition: In 43:42: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability

candidates.label: cand-1492: Topic from 43:45
candidates.definition: In 43:45: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped

candidates.label: cand-1493: Topic from 43:48
candidates.definition: In 43:48: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith]

candidates.label: cand-1494: Topic from 43:51
candidates.definition: In 43:51: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see

candidates.label: cand-1495: Topic from 43:54
candidates.definition: In 43:54: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah]

candidates.label: cand-1496: Topic from 43:57
candidates.definition: In 43:57: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud

candidates.label: cand-1497: Topic from 43:61
candidates.definition: In 43:61: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path

candidates.label: cand-1498: Topic from 43:63
candidates.definition: In 43:63: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me

candidates.label: cand-1499: Topic from 43:66
candidates.definition: In 43:66: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not

candidates.label: cand-1500: Topic from 43:69
candidates.definition: In 43:69: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims

candidates.label: cand-1501: Topic from 43:72
candidates.definition: In 43:72: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do

candidates.label: cand-1502: Topic from 43:75
candidates.definition: In 43:75: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair

candidates.label: cand-1503: Topic from 43:77
candidates.definition: In 43:77: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain

candidates.label: cand-1504: Topic from 43:80
candidates.definition: In 43:80: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording

candidates.label: cand-1505: Topic from 43:83
candidates.definition: In 43:83: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised

candidates.label: cand-1506: Topic from 43:86
candidates.definition: In 43:86: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know

candidates.label: cand-1507: Topic from 44:1
candidates.definition: In 44:1: Ha, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1508: Topic from 44:3
candidates.definition: In 44:3: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind]

candidates.label: cand-1509: Topic from 44:6
candidates.definition: In 44:6: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing

candidates.label: cand-1510: Topic from 44:9
candidates.definition: In 44:9: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves

candidates.label: cand-1511: Topic from 44:12
candidates.definition: In 44:12: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers

candidates.label: cand-1512: Topic from 44:15
candidates.definition: In 44:15: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief]

candidates.label: cand-1513: Topic from 44:18
candidates.definition: In 44:18: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger

candidates.label: cand-1514: Topic from 44:21
candidates.definition: In 44:21: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone

candidates.label: cand-1515: Topic from 44:24
candidates.definition: In 44:24: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned

candidates.label: cand-1516: Topic from 44:27
candidates.definition: In 44:27: And comfort wherein they were amused

candidates.label: cand-1517: Topic from 44:31
candidates.definition: In 44:31: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors

candidates.label: cand-1518: Topic from 44:33
candidates.definition: In 44:33: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial

candidates.label: cand-1519: Topic from 44:36
candidates.definition: In 44:36: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful

candidates.label: cand-1520: Topic from 44:39
candidates.definition: In 44:39: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know

candidates.label: cand-1521: Topic from 44:42
candidates.definition: In 44:42: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

candidates.label: cand-1522: Topic from 44:45
candidates.definition: In 44:45: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

candidates.label: cand-1523: Topic from 44:47
candidates.definition: In 44:47: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire

candidates.label: cand-1524: Topic from 44:50
candidates.definition: In 44:50: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute

candidates.label: cand-1525: Topic from 44:53
candidates.definition: In 44:53: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other

candidates.label: cand-1526: Topic from 44:56
candidates.definition: In 44:56: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

candidates.label: cand-1527: Topic from 45:1
candidates.definition: In 45:1: Ha, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1528: Topic from 45:2
candidates.definition: In 45:2: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1529: Topic from 45:4
candidates.definition: In 45:4: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith]

candidates.label: cand-1530: Topic from 45:6
candidates.definition: In 45:6: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe

candidates.label: cand-1531: Topic from 45:8
candidates.definition: In 45:8: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-1532: Topic from 45:10
candidates.definition: In 45:10: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment

candidates.label: cand-1533: Topic from 45:11
candidates.definition: In 45:11: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature

candidates.label: cand-1534: Topic from 45:13
candidates.definition: In 45:13: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

candidates.label: cand-1535: Topic from 45:15
candidates.definition: In 45:15: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned

candidates.label: cand-1536: Topic from 45:17
candidates.definition: In 45:17: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

candidates.label: cand-1537: Topic from 45:20
candidates.definition: In 45:20: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith]

candidates.label: cand-1538: Topic from 45:21
candidates.definition: In 45:21: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge

candidates.label: cand-1539: Topic from 45:23
candidates.definition: In 45:23: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded

candidates.label: cand-1540: Topic from 45:25
candidates.definition: In 45:25: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful

candidates.label: cand-1541: Topic from 45:26
candidates.definition: In 45:26: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know

candidates.label: cand-1542: Topic from 45:28
candidates.definition: In 45:28: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do

candidates.label: cand-1543: Topic from 45:30
candidates.definition: In 45:30: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment

candidates.label: cand-1544: Topic from 45:31
candidates.definition: In 45:31: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals

candidates.label: cand-1545: Topic from 45:33
candidates.definition: In 45:33: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule

candidates.label: cand-1546: Topic from 45:35
candidates.definition: In 45:35: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah]

candidates.label: cand-1547: Topic from 46:1
candidates.definition: In 46:1: Ha, Meem

candidates.label: cand-1548: Topic from 46:2
candidates.definition: In 46:2: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1549: Topic from 46:4
candidates.definition: In 46:4: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful

candidates.label: cand-1550: Topic from 46:6
candidates.definition: In 46:6: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship

candidates.label: cand-1551: Topic from 46:7
candidates.definition: In 46:7: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic

candidates.label: cand-1552: Topic from 46:9
candidates.definition: In 46:9: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner

candidates.label: cand-1553: Topic from 46:11
candidates.definition: In 46:11: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood

candidates.label: cand-1554: Topic from 46:12
candidates.definition: In 46:12: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good

candidates.label: cand-1555: Topic from 46:14
candidates.definition: In 46:14: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do

candidates.label: cand-1556: Topic from 46:16
candidates.definition: In 46:16: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised

candidates.label: cand-1557: Topic from 46:19
candidates.definition: In 46:19: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged

candidates.label: cand-1558: Topic from 46:20
candidates.definition: In 46:20: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient

candidates.label: cand-1559: Topic from 46:22
candidates.definition: In 46:22: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful

candidates.label: cand-1560: Topic from 46:23
candidates.definition: In 46:23: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allah, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly

candidates.label: cand-1561: Topic from 46:25
candidates.definition: In 46:25: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people

candidates.label: cand-1562: Topic from 46:27
candidates.definition: In 46:27: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief]

candidates.label: cand-1563: Topic from 46:28
candidates.definition: In 46:28: Then why did those they took besides Allah as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing

candidates.label: cand-1564: Topic from 46:30
candidates.definition: In 46:30: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path

candidates.label: cand-1565: Topic from 46:31
candidates.definition: In 46:31: O our people, respond to the Messenger of Allah and believe in him; Allah will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-1566: Topic from 46:33
candidates.definition: In 46:33: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent

candidates.label: cand-1567: Topic from 47:1
candidates.definition: In 47:1: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds

candidates.label: cand-1568: Topic from 47:2
candidates.definition: In 47:2: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition

candidates.label: cand-1569: Topic from 47:4
candidates.definition: In 47:4: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds

candidates.label: cand-1570: Topic from 47:6
candidates.definition: In 47:6: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them

candidates.label: cand-1571: Topic from 47:8
candidates.definition: In 47:8: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds

candidates.label: cand-1572: Topic from 47:10
candidates.definition: In 47:10: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable

candidates.label: cand-1573: Topic from 47:11
candidates.definition: In 47:11: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector

candidates.label: cand-1574: Topic from 47:13
candidates.definition: In 47:13: And how many a city was stronger than your city [Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them

candidates.label: cand-1575: Topic from 47:15
candidates.definition: In 47:15: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines

candidates.label: cand-1576: Topic from 47:17
candidates.definition: In 47:17: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness

candidates.label: cand-1577: Topic from 47:20
candidates.definition: In 47:20: Those who believe say, "Why has a surah not been sent down? But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]

candidates.label: cand-1578: Topic from 47:21
candidates.definition: In 47:21: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them

candidates.label: cand-1579: Topic from 47:23
candidates.definition: In 47:23: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision

candidates.label: cand-1580: Topic from 47:25
candidates.definition: In 47:25: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them

candidates.label: cand-1581: Topic from 47:27
candidates.definition: In 47:27: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs

candidates.label: cand-1582: Topic from 47:29
candidates.definition: In 47:29: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred

candidates.label: cand-1583: Topic from 47:30
candidates.definition: In 47:30: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allah knows your deeds

candidates.label: cand-1584: Topic from 47:32
candidates.definition: In 47:32: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds

candidates.label: cand-1585: Topic from 47:34
