candidates.definition: In 55:31: We will attend to you, O prominent beings

candidates.label: cand-1736: Topic from 55:35
candidates.definition: In 55:35: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves

candidates.label: cand-1737: Topic from 55:40
candidates.definition: In 55:40: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

candidates.label: cand-1738: Topic from 55:43
candidates.definition: In 55:43: This is Hell, which the criminals deny

candidates.label: cand-1739: Topic from 55:47
candidates.definition: In 55:47: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

candidates.label: cand-1740: Topic from 55:51
candidates.definition: In 55:51: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

candidates.label: cand-1741: Topic from 55:55
candidates.definition: In 55:55: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

candidates.label: cand-1742: Topic from 55:59
candidates.definition: In 55:59: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

candidates.label: cand-1743: Topic from 55:62
candidates.definition: In 55:62: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens

candidates.label: cand-1744: Topic from 55:66
candidates.definition: In 55:66: In both of them are two springs, spouting

candidates.label: cand-1745: Topic from 55:70
candidates.definition: In 55:70: In them are good and beautiful women

candidates.label: cand-1746: Topic from 55:74
candidates.definition: In 55:74: Untouched before them by man or jinni

candidates.label: cand-1747: Topic from 56:1
candidates.definition: In 56:1: When the Occurrence occurs

candidates.label: cand-1748: Topic from 56:4
candidates.definition: In 56:4: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

candidates.label: cand-1749: Topic from 56:7
candidates.definition: In 56:7: And you become [of] three kinds

candidates.label: cand-1750: Topic from 56:10
candidates.definition: In 56:10: And the forerunners, the forerunners

candidates.label: cand-1751: Topic from 56:13
candidates.definition: In 56:13: A [large] company of the former peoples

candidates.label: cand-1752: Topic from 56:16
candidates.definition: In 56:16: Reclining on them, facing each other

candidates.label: cand-1753: Topic from 56:19
candidates.definition: In 56:19: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated

candidates.label: cand-1754: Topic from 56:22
candidates.definition: In 56:22: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes

candidates.label: cand-1755: Topic from 56:25
candidates.definition: In 56:25: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin

candidates.label: cand-1756: Topic from 56:28
candidates.definition: In 56:28: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

candidates.label: cand-1757: Topic from 56:33
candidates.definition: In 56:33: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden

candidates.label: cand-1758: Topic from 56:36
candidates.definition: In 56:36: And made them virgins

candidates.label: cand-1759: Topic from 56:39
candidates.definition: In 56:39: A company of the former peoples

candidates.label: cand-1760: Topic from 56:42
candidates.definition: In 56:42: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

candidates.label: cand-1761: Topic from 56:45
candidates.definition: In 56:45: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence

candidates.label: cand-1762: Topic from 56:48
candidates.definition: In 56:48: And our forefathers [as well]

candidates.label: cand-1763: Topic from 56:51
candidates.definition: In 56:51: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers

candidates.label: cand-1764: Topic from 56:54
candidates.definition: In 56:54: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

candidates.label: cand-1765: Topic from 56:57
candidates.definition: In 56:57: We have created you, so why do you not believe

candidates.label: cand-1766: Topic from 56:60
candidates.definition: In 56:60: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

candidates.label: cand-1767: Topic from 56:65
candidates.definition: In 56:65: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder

candidates.label: cand-1768: Topic from 56:68
candidates.definition: In 56:68: And have you seen the water that you drink

candidates.label: cand-1769: Topic from 56:71
candidates.definition: In 56:71: And have you seen the fire that you ignite

candidates.label: cand-1770: Topic from 56:74
candidates.definition: In 56:74: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great

candidates.label: cand-1771: Topic from 56:77
candidates.definition: In 56:77: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an

candidates.label: cand-1772: Topic from 56:80
candidates.definition: In 56:80: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds

candidates.label: cand-1773: Topic from 56:83
candidates.definition: In 56:83: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat

candidates.label: cand-1774: Topic from 56:86
candidates.definition: In 56:86: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed

candidates.label: cand-1775: Topic from 56:89
candidates.definition: In 56:89: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure

candidates.label: cand-1776: Topic from 56:92
candidates.definition: In 56:92: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray

candidates.label: cand-1777: Topic from 57:1
candidates.definition: In 57:1: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1778: Topic from 57:2
candidates.definition: In 57:2: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent

candidates.label: cand-1779: Topic from 57:3
candidates.definition: In 57:3: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing

candidates.label: cand-1780: Topic from 57:5
candidates.definition: In 57:5: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned [all] matters

candidates.label: cand-1781: Topic from 57:6
candidates.definition: In 57:6: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and he is Knowing of that within the breasts

candidates.label: cand-1782: Topic from 57:8
candidates.definition: In 57:8: And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers

candidates.label: cand-1783: Topic from 57:9
candidates.definition: In 57:9: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muhammad] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful

candidates.label: cand-1784: Topic from 57:10
candidates.definition: In 57:10: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allah has promised the best [reward]. And Allah, with what you do, is Acquainted

candidates.label: cand-1785: Topic from 57:12
candidates.definition: In 57:12: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment

candidates.label: cand-1786: Topic from 57:13
candidates.definition: In 57:13: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment

candidates.label: cand-1787: Topic from 57:16
candidates.definition: In 57:16: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient

candidates.label: cand-1788: Topic from 57:17
candidates.definition: In 57:17: Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand

candidates.label: cand-1789: Topic from 57:18
candidates.definition: In 57:18: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward

candidates.label: cand-1790: Topic from 57:19
candidates.definition: In 57:19: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire

candidates.label: cand-1791: Topic from 57:21
candidates.definition: In 57:21: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty

candidates.label: cand-1792: Topic from 57:22
candidates.definition: In 57:22: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah, is easy

candidates.label: cand-1793: Topic from 57:23
candidates.definition: In 57:23: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful

candidates.label: cand-1794: Topic from 57:25
candidates.definition: In 57:25: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allah may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might

candidates.label: cand-1795: Topic from 57:26
candidates.definition: In 57:26: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient

candidates.label: cand-1796: Topic from 57:27
candidates.definition: In 57:27: Then We sent following their footsteps Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allah. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient

candidates.label: cand-1797: Topic from 58:1
candidates.definition: In 58:1: Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you, [O Muhammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah. And Allah hears your dialogue; indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing

candidates.label: cand-1798: Topic from 58:2
candidates.definition: In 58:2: Those who pronounce thihar among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving

candidates.label: cand-1799: Topic from 58:3
candidates.definition: In 58:3: And those who pronounce thihar from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allah is Acquainted with what you do

candidates.label: cand-1800: Topic from 58:4
candidates.definition: In 58:4: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allah and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allah. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-1801: Topic from 58:5
candidates.definition: In 58:5: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment

candidates.label: cand-1802: Topic from 58:6
candidates.definition: In 58:6: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allah had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allah is, over all things, Witness

candidates.label: cand-1803: Topic from 58:7
candidates.definition: In 58:7: Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing

candidates.label: cand-1804: Topic from 58:8
candidates.definition: In 58:8: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation, then they return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allah does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?" Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination

candidates.label: cand-1805: Topic from 58:9
candidates.definition: In 58:9: O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered

candidates.label: cand-1806: Topic from 58:10
candidates.definition: In 58:10: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely

candidates.label: cand-1807: Topic from 58:12
candidates.definition: In 58:12: O you who have believed, when you [wish to] privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not [the means] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

candidates.label: cand-1808: Topic from 58:13
candidates.definition: In 58:13: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allah has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do

candidates.label: cand-1809: Topic from 58:14
candidates.definition: In 58:14: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying]

candidates.label: cand-1810: Topic from 58:15
candidates.definition: In 58:15: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing

candidates.label: cand-1811: Topic from 58:16
candidates.definition: In 58:16: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment

candidates.label: cand-1812: Topic from 58:17
candidates.definition: In 58:17: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

candidates.label: cand-1813: Topic from 58:18
candidates.definition: In 58:18: On the Day Allah will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something. Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars

candidates.label: cand-1814: Topic from 58:19
candidates.definition: In 58:19: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allah. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers

candidates.label: cand-1815: Topic from 58:20
candidates.definition: In 58:20: Indeed, the ones who oppose Allah and His Messenger - those will be among the most humbled

candidates.label: cand-1816: Topic from 58:21
candidates.definition: In 58:21: Allah has written, "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might

candidates.label: cand-1817: Topic from 59:1
candidates.definition: In 59:1: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1818: Topic from 59:2
candidates.definition: In 59:2: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allah; but [the decree of] Allah came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the believers. So take warning, O people of vision

candidates.label: cand-1819: Topic from 59:3
candidates.definition: In 59:3: And if not that Allah had decreed for them evacuation, He would have punished them in [this] world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire

candidates.label: cand-1820: Topic from 59:4
candidates.definition: In 59:4: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah - then indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

candidates.label: cand-1821: Topic from 59:5
candidates.definition: In 59:5: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allah and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient

candidates.label: cand-1822: Topic from 59:6
candidates.definition: In 59:6: And what Allah restored [of property] to His Messenger from them - you did not spur for it [in an expedition] any horses or camels, but Allah gives His messengers power over whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent

candidates.label: cand-1823: Topic from 59:7
candidates.definition: In 59:7: And what Allah restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allah and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and orphans and the [stranded] traveler - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

candidates.label: cand-1824: Topic from 59:8
candidates.definition: In 59:8: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allah and [His] approval and supporting Allah and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful

candidates.label: cand-1825: Topic from 59:9
candidates.definition: In 59:9: And [also for] those who were settled in al-Madinah and [adopted] the faith before them. They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what the emigrants were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful

candidates.label: cand-1826: Topic from 59:10
candidates.definition: In 59:10: And [there is a share for] those who came after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful

candidates.label: cand-1827: Topic from 59:13
candidates.definition: In 59:13: You [believers] are more fearful within their breasts than Allah. That is because they are a people who do not understand

candidates.label: cand-1828: Topic from 59:14
candidates.definition: In 59:14: They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason

candidates.label: cand-1829: Topic from 59:15
candidates.definition: In 59:15: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment

candidates.label: cand-1830: Topic from 59:16
candidates.definition: In 59:16: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds

candidates.label: cand-1831: Topic from 59:17
candidates.definition: In 59:17: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrong-doers

candidates.label: cand-1832: Topic from 59:18
candidates.definition: In 59:18: O you who have believed, fear Allah. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what you do

candidates.label: cand-1833: Topic from 59:19
candidates.definition: In 59:19: And be not like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient

candidates.label: cand-1834: Topic from 59:20
candidates.definition: In 59:20: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success]

candidates.label: cand-1835: Topic from 59:21
candidates.definition: In 59:21: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought

candidates.label: cand-1836: Topic from 59:22
candidates.definition: In 59:22: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

candidates.label: cand-1837: Topic from 60:1
candidates.definition: In 60:1: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allah, your Lord. If you have come out for jihad in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection, but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way

candidates.label: cand-1838: Topic from 60:1
candidates.definition: In 60:1: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allah, your Lord. If you have come out for jihad in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection, but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way

candidates.label: cand-1839: Topic from 60:2
candidates.definition: In 60:2: If they gain dominance over you, they would be to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve

candidates.label: cand-1840: Topic from 60:2
candidates.definition: In 60:2: If they gain dominance over you, they would be to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve

candidates.label: cand-1841: Topic from 60:3
candidates.definition: In 60:3: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing

candidates.label: cand-1842: Topic from 60:4
candidates.definition: In 60:4: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allah. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allah alone" except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allah. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination

candidates.label: cand-1843: Topic from 60:4
candidates.definition: In 60:4: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allah. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allah alone" except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allah. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination

candidates.label: cand-1844: Topic from 60:5
candidates.definition: In 60:5: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1845: Topic from 60:5
candidates.definition: In 60:5: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

candidates.label: cand-1846: Topic from 60:6
candidates.definition: In 60:6: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy

candidates.label: cand-1847: Topic from 60:8
candidates.definition: In 60:8: Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly

candidates.label: cand-1848: Topic from 60:8
candidates.definition: In 60:8: Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly

candidates.label: cand-1849: Topic from 60:9
candidates.definition: In 60:9: Allah only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers

candidates.label: cand-1850: Topic from 60:9
candidates.definition: In 60:9: Allah only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers

candidates.label: cand-1851: Topic from 60:10
candidates.definition: In 60:10: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine them. Allah is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give the disbelievers what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of Allah; He judges between you. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

candidates.label: cand-1852: Topic from 60:10
candidates.definition: In 60:10: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine them. Allah is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give the disbelievers what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of Allah; He judges between you. And Allah is Knowing and Wise
